面向全球气象监测与SAR能力建设 云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作
云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作 随着商业航天进入规模化组网发展的新阶段，产业链协同创新正成为推动商业卫星高质量发展的重要支撑。从单星研制迈向星座建设，从单一能力迈向多载荷融合，如何构建高效率、高可靠的卫星研制与批量交付体

### 云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作
随着商业航天进入规模化组网发展的新阶段，产业链协同创新正成为推动商业卫星高质量发展的重要支撑。从单星研制迈向星座建设，从单一能力迈向多载荷融合，如何构建高效率、高可靠的卫星研制与批量交付体系，成为商业航天发展的重要课题。

围绕全球气象监测网络建设和SAR能力布局，近日，天津云遥宇航科技有限公司（以下简称“云遥宇航”）与湖南航升卫星科技有限公司（以下简称“航升卫星”）在天津签署战略合作框架协议。双方将围绕全球SAR星座建设、新一代气象监测星座建设、卫星平台与载荷一体化适配等方向开展深度合作，进一步整合产业链优势资源，推进关键技术协同创新，共同提升商业星座建设能力。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg18_260709085016A395.webp)

### 从全球气象监测走向多源遥感能力建设

近年来，云遥宇航持续推进商业气象卫星建设，不断完善覆盖全球的气象监测网络。

公司核心工程——云遥气象星座，规划部署90颗掩星探测卫星和24颗综合探测卫星。截至目前，星座已成功发射47颗卫星，系列卫星已进入中国气象局综合气象观测系统并实现业务运行，每日产出数万条专业气象数据产品，为气象服务、防灾减灾、新能源功率预测、电力交易、远洋船舶导航等领域提供持续稳定的数据服务支撑。

在持续完善气象数据能力的同时，云遥宇航近年来不断拓展SAR技术布局，围绕SAR载荷开展持续研发，经过多年的技术积累，已形成覆盖系统设计仿真、载荷研发、总装总测等环节的研发能力，为构建多源遥感数据服务体系奠定了技术基础。

### 聚焦能力协同 提升星座建设效率

随着全球气象监测星座持续推进以及SAR业务不断拓展，云遥宇航对于卫星平台工程化、批量制造能力以及平台与载荷协同设计能力提出了更高要求。

基于双方在产业链不同环节形成的能力优势，此次合作将进一步推动卫星平台与载荷协同设计、整星研制和规模化制造能力建设，为商业星座建设提供更加高效的技术支撑。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg19_260709085131A396.webp)

### 围绕两大方向推进合作落地

双方将围绕全球SAR星座建设和新一代全球气象监测星座建设开展合作。

在SAR方向，双方将协同推进SAR载荷与大功率卫星平台一体化研制，计划于2027年完成首颗SAR卫星发射及在轨验证，2028年完成不少于3颗SAR卫星研制发射。

在新一代全球气象监测星座建设方面，双方计划于2026年完成不少于3颗卫星研制，2027年完成不少于10颗卫星研制发射，持续提升全球气象监测网络建设能力。

### 发挥产业链优势 推动协同创新

签约仪式上，**云遥宇航表示，航升卫星在卫星平台设计和整星集成方面具备成熟的工程化能力，可有效支撑云遥气象星座高密度组网发射需求。通过平台与载荷的一体化适配，将进一步提升卫星研制效率和批量化生产能力，共同赋能商业星座规模化建设和产业创新发展。**

航升卫星表示，**云遥宇航持续稳定的星座组网发射任务，将为公司卫星联合研制、批量交付、大功率平台在轨验证以及SAR卫星整星研制提供重要应用场景，加速新一代卫星平台技术迭代优化和产业化进程**

### 共同探索商业航天产业新空间

当前，商业航天正从单点技术突破迈向产业链协同发展新阶段。平台、载荷、数据、应用等环节之间的深度协作，正在成为推动产业规模化发展的重要动力。

此次战略合作，是云遥宇航持续推进全球气象监测能力建设和SAR能力布局的重要一步。未来，双方将继续围绕卫星技术创新、星座建设和产业协同开展深入合作，积极服务国家"十五五"时期商业航天发展需求，推动国产商业卫星技术持续进步，加快商业SAR卫星和全球气象监测卫星规模化建设，为新能源、航海、低空经济等领域提供更加丰富、高效的空间信息服务，助力我国商业航天产业高质量发展。

### Yunyao Aerospace and Hangsheng Satellite have established a strategic partnership.

As commercial spaceflight enters a new stage of large-scale network development, collaborative innovation within the industrial chain is becoming a crucial support for promoting the high-quality development of commercial satellites. Moving from the development of individual satellites to the construction of constellations, and from a single capability to multi-load integration, how to establish an efficient and reliable satellite development and batch delivery system has become an important issue for the development of commercial spaceflight. 

In recent days, Tianjin Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yunyao Aerospace") and Hunan Hangsheng Satellite Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Hangsheng Satellite") signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement in Tianjin. The two parties will carry out in-depth cooperation in directions such as global SAR constellation construction, new-generation meteorological monitoring constellation construction, and integration of satellite platforms and payloads, further integrating the advantageous resources of the industrial chain, promoting collaborative innovation in key technologies, and jointly enhancing the construction capabilities of commercial constellations.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg18_260709085417A397.webp)

### From global meteorological monitoring to the construction of multi-source remote sensing capabilities

In recent years, Yunyao Aerospace has been continuously advancing the construction of commercial meteorological satellites and continuously improving the global meteorological monitoring network.

The core project of the company - Yunyao Meteorological Constellation - plans to deploy 90 occultation detection satellites and 24 comprehensive detection satellites. As of now, the constellation has successfully launched 47 satellites, and the series of satellites have entered the China Meteorological Administration's comprehensive meteorological observation system and achieved operational use. They produce tens of thousands of professional meteorological data products every day, providing continuous and stable data service support for meteorological services, disaster prevention and mitigation, power generation prediction for new energy, power trading, navigation of ocean-going vessels, and other fields.

While continuously improving the meteorological data capabilities, Yunyao Aerospace has been expanding its SAR technology layout in recent years. It has carried out continuous research and development around SAR payloads. After years of technological accumulation, it has formed a research and development capability covering system design simulation, payload development, assembly and testing, etc., laying a technical foundation for building a multi-source remote sensing data service system.

### Focusing on collaborative capabilities to enhance the efficiency of constellation construction

With the continuous advancement of the global meteorological monitoring constellation and the continuous expansion of SAR business, Cloud Remote Space Agency has raised higher requirements for the engineeringization and batch manufacturing capabilities of satellite platforms, as well as the collaborative design capabilities between the platform and payloads.

Based on the respective capability advantages formed by both parties in different links of the industrial chain, this cooperation will further promote the collaborative design of satellite platforms and payloads, the integrated satellite development and the construction of large-scale manufacturing capabilities, providing more efficient technical support for the construction of commercial constellations.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg19_260709085611A398.webp)

### Push forward the implementation of cooperation in two major directions

The two sides will carry out cooperation on the construction of the global SAR constellation and the new generation of global meteorological monitoring constellation.

In the SAR field, the two sides will jointly promote the integrated research and development of SAR payloads and high-power satellite platforms. They plan to complete the launch and in-orbit verification of the first SAR satellite in 2027, and complete the research and launch of no less than 3 SAR satellites in 2028.

In the construction of the new generation of global meteorological monitoring constellation, the two sides plan to complete the research and development of no less than 3 satellites in 2026, and complete the research and launch of no less than 10 satellites in 2027, continuously enhancing the construction capacity of the global meteorological monitoring network.

### Utilize the advantages of the industrial chain and promote collaborative innovation

At the signing ceremony,** Yun Yao Aerospace stated that the Hang Sheng satellite has mature engineering capabilities in satellite platform design and overall satellite integration, which can effectively support the high-density networking launch requirements of the Yun Yao meteorological constellation. Through the integration and adaptation of the platform and payloads, it will further enhance the satellite development efficiency and batch production capacity, and jointly empower the large-scale construction of commercial constellations and the innovation of industrial development.**

Hang Sheng satellite stated that **the continuous and stable constellation networking launch tasks of Yun Yao Aerospace will provide important application scenarios for the company's satellite joint research and development, batch delivery, large-power platform in-orbit verification, and SAR satellite overall satellite research and development, accelerating the technological iteration and industrialization process of the new-generation satellite platform.**

### Jointly explore new frontiers in the commercial aerospace industry

Currently, commercial aerospace is moving from single technological breakthroughs to a new stage of coordinated development of the industrial chain. The deep collaboration among various links such as platforms, payloads, data, and applications is becoming an important driving force for the industrial scale development.

This strategic cooperation is an important step for Yunyao Aerospace to continuously promote the construction of global meteorological monitoring capabilities and SAR capability layout. In the future, both parties will continue to carry out in-depth cooperation around satellite technological innovation, constellation construction, and industrial collaboration, actively serving the commercial aerospace development needs of the "15th Five-Year Plan" period of the country, promoting the continuous progress of domestic commercial satellite technology, accelerating the large-scale construction of commercial SAR satellites and global meteorological monitoring satellites, providing more abundant and efficient space information services for fields such as new energy, navigation, and low-altitude economy, and helping to promote the high-quality development of China's commercial aerospace industry.

6月25日至26日，由北极星电力网主办的2026第八届综合能源服务与零碳园区建设大会在江苏盐城盛大召开。大会汇聚国家电网、南方电网下属综合能源企业、行业研究机构及众多综合能源服务领军企业，围绕新型电力系统、零碳园区、虚拟电厂、碳市场等热点话题展开深度研讨。作为国内领先的全产业链商业气象数据运营商、国家级重点专精特新"小巨人"企业，天津云遥宇航科技有限公司（以下简称"云遥宇航"）受邀参会，发表主题报告、设立专题展台，并在同期举行的2026年度"北极星杯"综合能源服务影响力评选中，荣膺"综合能源服务创新先锋企业"称号，成为本届该荣誉获评企业中唯一一家商业卫星企业。

### 01 聚焦零碳园区

2026年是"十五五"规划的开局之年，也是零碳园区建设从"试点示范"迈向"规模化推广"的关键节点。在国家"双碳"战略纵深推进的背景下，综合能源服务正成为园区实现绿色低碳转型的核心引擎。本届大会连续两天安排了三十余场主题报告与项目参观，与会嘉宾就源网荷储一体化、绿电供应、电力交易、碳资产管理等议题展开了热烈交流。

![](/media/news/ryjxImg34_260702135116A338.webp)
云遥宇航商业气象卫星专题展台

作为参会企业中独具"空天"特色的代表，云遥宇航的亮相为大会带来了独特的卫星视角。公司自2019年成立于天津港保税区以来，已构建起从卫星载荷整星研制、数据生产到行业应用的完整技术体系，并率先将航天级气象遥感能力下沉应用于新型电力系统与零碳园区建设，受到与会专家的广泛关注。

### 02 空天地一体化赋能

![](/media/news/ryjxImg35_260702135203A339.webp)
云遥宇航气象技术负责人作专题报告

大会期间，云遥宇航气象技术负责人作《高密度商业气象卫星提升新能源电力系统预测能力》的专题报告，从气象卫星与碳卫星的独特视角，系统阐述了空天地一体化技术如何赋能零碳园区建设。

报告指出，云遥宇航目前已成功发射47颗商业气象卫星，正在加快建设由90颗气象卫星和24颗遥感卫星组成的两大星座，可提供12—20分钟级、百米级分辨率的商业气象服务能力，为新型电力系统提供高时空分辨率的环境感知底座。

他表示，随着新能源高比例接入，电力系统的波动性和瞬时性显著增强，对气候环境的精细化感知提出了更高要求。对此，云遥宇航通过将AI气象预测、新能源功率预测与虚拟电厂平台深度耦合，并结合碳卫星动态捕捉空气中的碳足迹，构建起"星地互联"的立体监测网络，预报精度在实际运行中优于行业平均水平，有效破解了综合能源服务中"预测不准、算不清碳、调控粗放"的行业痛点。

面向未来，他提出，零碳园区将逐步演变为"发、储、荷、碳、证、市"协同运营的复杂节点，智能体将成为园区运营者的"贴心秘书"，化繁为简、提质增效，帮助园区构建起可运行、可审计、可复制的零碳园区运营能力。这一前瞻判断，引发了现场嘉宾的广泛共鸣。

### 03 荣膺北极星杯

![](/media/news/ryjxImg36_260702135253A340.webp)
云遥宇航荣膺2026"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业

![](/media/news/ryjxImg38_260702135324A341.webp)
2026"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业奖牌

这一荣誉，是行业对云遥宇航"天基气象感知、智能功率预测、碳电协同调度"差异化技术路线的高度认可。依托自有的高密度商业气象卫星星座资产，云遥宇航以虚拟电厂（VPP）为核心调控手段、以卫星遥感与地面物联网协同感知为底座、以碳资产价值变现为闭环，打造了园区级综合能源服务系统，在技术原创性、商业模式延展性与生态降碳效益上均取得突破性成果。

Yunyaoyun Aerospace made its debut at the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference in 2026, and was honored as the "Polar Star Cup" Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services Innovation.
From June 25th to 26th, the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference, organized by the Polaris Power Grid, was grandly held in Yancheng, Jiang

From June 25th to 26th, the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference, organized by the Polaris Power Grid, was grandly held in Yancheng, Jiangsu Province. The conference brought together enterprises of comprehensive energy services under State Grid and Southern Grid, industry research institutions, and numerous leading enterprises in comprehensive energy services. It conducted in-depth discussions on hot topics such as the new power system, zero-carbon parks, virtual power plants, and carbon markets. As a leading domestic full-chain commercial meteorological data operator and a national-level key specialized "little giant" enterprise, Tianjin Yunyao Yuhang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yunyao Yuhang") was invited to attend the conference, delivered a keynote report, set up a special exhibition booth, and won the title of "Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services" in the 2026 Annual "Polaris Cup" Comprehensive Energy Services Influence Evaluation, becoming the only commercial satellite enterprise among the enterprises that won this honor in this year.

### I. Focus on Zero-Carbon Parks

2026 is the starting year of the 15th Five Year Plan and a key milestone for the transition of zero carbon park construction from "pilot demonstration" to "large-scale promotion". Against the backdrop of the deepening of the national "dual carbon" strategy, comprehensive energy services are becoming the core engine for parks to achieve green and low-carbon transformation. This conference has arranged more than 30 themed presentations and project visits for two consecutive days, and the attending guests have had lively exchanges on topics such as source grid load storage integration, green power supply, power trading, and carbon asset management.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg34_260702135743A344.webp)
Cloudy Sky Aerospace Commercial Meteorological Satellite Exhibition Stand

As a representative of the participating enterprises with unique "space and aviation" characteristics, Yunyao Aerospace's appearance brought a distinctive satellite perspective to the conference. Since its establishment in Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone in 2019, the company has built a complete technical system covering satellite payload integrated satellite development, data production, and industry application. It was the first to apply the aerospace-level meteorological remote sensing capabilities to the construction of new power systems and zero-carbon parks, attracting widespread attention from the experts present.

### II. Integrated Capability of Air, Land and Space

![](/media/news/ryjxImg35_260702135856A345.webp)
The head of Yunyao Aerospace Meteorological Technology delivered a special report.

During the conference, the person in charge of Yunyao Aerospace Meteorological Technology gave a special report on "Enhancing the Predictive Capability of New Energy Power Systems with High Density Commercial Meteorological Satellites". From the unique perspectives of meteorological satellites and carbon satellites, the report systematically explained how the integration of space, sky, and earth technology can empower the construction of zero carbon parks.

The report points out that Yunyao Aerospace has successfully launched 47 commercial meteorological satellites and is accelerating the construction of two major constellations consisting of 90 meteorological satellites and 24 remote sensing satellites, which can provide commercial meteorological service capabilities with resolutions of 12-20 minutes and 100 meters, and provide a high spatiotemporal resolution environmental perception base for the new power system.

He stated that with the high proportion of new energy integration, the volatility and transience of the power system have significantly increased, posing higher requirements for refined perception of the climate environment. In response, Yunyao Aerospace has deeply coupled AI weather prediction, new energy power prediction, and virtual power plant platform, and combined them with carbon satellites to dynamically capture carbon footprints in the air, building a three-dimensional monitoring network of "satellite ground interconnection". The forecast accuracy is better than the industry average level in actual operation, effectively solving the industry pain points of "inaccurate prediction, unclear carbon calculation, and extensive regulation" in comprehensive energy services.

Looking towards the future, he proposed that zero carbon parks will gradually evolve into complex nodes of "generation, storage, loading, carbon, certification, and city" collaborative operation. Intelligent agents will become the "intimate secretaries" of park operators, simplifying complexity, improving quality and efficiency, and helping parks build operational, auditable, and replicable zero carbon park operation capabilities. This forward-looking judgment has sparked widespread resonance among the guests present.

### III. Won the Polaris Cup

![](/media/news/ryjxImg36_260702140055A346.webp)
Yunyao Aerospace has been awarded the title of "Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services" for 2026 by the "Polar Star Cup".

On the afternoon of June 25th, the award ceremony for the 2026 "Polar Star Cup" Comprehensive Energy Service Influence Evaluation was grandly held at the conference venue. This evaluation was initiated by the Polar Star Power Network and adhered to the principles of "fairness, impartiality, and openness", aiming to recognize enterprises that have excelled in optimizing comprehensive energy systems, intelligent management, and zero-carbon practices, and to set industry benchmarks. Through enterprise applications, expert group evaluations, and other stages, Yunyao Aerospace, with its innovative practice of "star-ground" interconnection of refined meteorological data to support the intelligent construction of zero-carbon parks in Tianjin, stood out among the numerous participating enterprises and was honored as the 2026 "Polar Star Cup" Comprehensive Energy Service Innovation Pioneer Enterprise.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg38_260702140140A347.webp)
2026 "Polaris Cup" Award for Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services

It is worth noting that among the list of enterprises recognized as "Innovative Pioneer Companies" in this year, Yunyao Aerospace is the only commercial satellite enterprise. This rarity is attributed to the company's core strength that spans the entire industrial chain of "satellite development - constellation operation - data processing - application services" - from the independent development of satellite payloads, constellation networking launch, to the production of meteorological data, intelligent forecasting and the application in the power industry. Yunyao Aerospace has bridged the "last mile" between commercial aerospace and energy and power, leveraging aerospace-level capabilities to support the new power system, making this award even more valuable and irreplaceable. 

This honor is a high recognition from the industry for Yunyao Aerospace's differentiated technical route of "space-based meteorological perception, intelligent power prediction, and carbon-electric coordinated scheduling". Relying on its own high-density commercial meteorological satellite constellation assets, Yunyao Aerospace uses virtual power plant (VPP) as the core control method, integrates satellite remote sensing and ground Internet of Things for coordinated perception as the foundation, and realizes the carbon asset value realization as the closed loop. It has created a park-level comprehensive energy service system, achieving breakthrough results in technological originality, business model extensibility, and ecological carbon reduction benefits.

### IV. Satellite Enabling Drives Attention

![](/media/news/ryjxImg39_260702140315A348.webp)
At the exhibition stand of Yunyao Aerospace, there was a continuous stream of consultations and exchanges among experts.

During the conference, Yunyao Aerospace set up a special exhibition booth at the venue, showcasing the "Cloudy Sky Weather Constellation" satellite model, the intelligent management platform for wind power prediction, and the comprehensive solution for zero-carbon parks. The exhibition booth theme of "Building a global meteorological remote sensing constellation and empowering the new power system with precise data" attracted many experts and colleagues to stop by for consultation, and there was a continuous flow of discussions and negotiations.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg40_260702140355A349.webp)
During the meeting, the staff interacted actively with the visitors.

The staff demonstrated on-site how satellite remote sensing data can be deeply integrated with power prediction, virtual power plants, and carbon asset management. This vividly showcased the practical value of the "space-ground-air integration" in the zero-carbon park scenario, allowing the attendees to directly experience the new possibilities that commercial meteorological satellites bring to integrated energy services.

### V. Conclusion

From the vast expanse of the sky to a zero-carbon park, Yunyao Aerospace is leveraging satellites as "eyes" and AI as "brains" to continuously promote the deep integration of aerospace technology and energy and power. The company will accelerate the progress of constellation networking and continuously deepen its applications in the fields of power, navigation, aviation, and low-altitude economy. In line with the "dual carbon" goals, Yunyao Aerospace, with this recognition as an "innovative pioneer enterprise in comprehensive energy service", will take this as a new starting point and collaborate with industry partners to contribute "Yunyao wisdom" to building a zero-carbon park operation capability that is operational, auditable, and replicable. This will also help in the construction of a new power system and the high-quality green development.

七月份广东市场边界条件预测

### 一 气象预报

#### 全国夏季及7月气候预测

7月广东省全省平均温度预计约27.0℃，较6月（25.5℃）有明显上升。受副热带高压与夏季季风交替影响，全省进入典型盛夏气候模式。降水方面，预计月内有1次持续时间较长的系统性降水过程，虽有短时降温作用，但降水前后的高湿环境将显著增加体感温度。

**珠三角**：处于高温核心区（月均约28℃），虽然沿海区域风速较大有助于散热，但高密度的建筑群会限制降温效果，同时降水较上月略多，呈现明显的“桑拿天”特征。

**粤西**：湛江等地月均温预计超过29℃，是全省的热中心，制冷负荷将出现爆发式增长；虽然沿海风速相对较大，但对降低极端高温引起的用电高峰贡献有限。

**粤东**：气温较高，且受南海水汽输送影响，降水较上月偏多，这种高温高湿环境使得空调除湿与降温能耗双重叠加。

**粤北**：气温较其他区域明显偏低（25~26℃），降水较上月有明显减少，负荷相对平稳。

![](/media/news/hyzxImg27_260702142401A362.webp)
2026年7月广东省各气象要素预报结果逐日变化

![](/media/news/hyzxImg28_260702142421A363.webp)
2026年7月广东省各气象要素月均值空间分布

### 二 统调负荷方面

基于气象与负荷的历史关系，预计2026年7月全省统调月均负荷预计在12.2万MW至13.1万MW之间，较6月进一步增长。

![](/media/news/hyzxImg29_260702142508A364.webp)
2025年5-7月统调负荷与各气象要素的散点图（阴影为95%置信区间）

从气象条件来看，2026年7月全省将由前期的暖湿过渡进入典型盛夏模式。在此背景下，制冷类负荷将由前期的逐步释放转为集中爆发，特别是粤西及珠三角地区，气温敏感性负荷将对总负荷有明显贡献。与此同时，月内持续性降水过程带来的高湿环境将显著延缓人体感官降温，导致夜间降温负荷退减缓慢，从而在较大时间尺度内显著抬升负荷基线。尽管沿海地区风速有所增强，但风速整体较小，难以抵消高温高湿带来的负荷增量。

### 三 西电东送方面

2026年1-6月西电送量整体呈稳步抬升趋势。 1-3月枯水期波动上行，始终高于2025年同期水平；3月后进入持续爬坡阶段，5月峰值突破30000MW；6月丰水期开启后，随着华南主汛期来临、珠江流域强降雨过程增多，上游来水明显加大，峰值进一步冲高至35000MW附近，全月中枢上移至25000-32000MW区间。7月华南主汛期进入高峰段，珠江流域及上游来水维持偏丰态势，水电出力具备满发及进一步释放条件，来水量预计维持阶段性高位运行，叠加流域水库调度和跨区通道利用提升，预计全月西电送入量中枢较2025年同期（35000-40000MW）偏高约3%-8%。7月西电东送将由6月“高位偏强、阶段性冲高”变化为“高位偏强，持续升高”，对广东日间及平段电价形成更强、更持续的压制；但在极端高温负荷和晚峰爬坡压力下，对尖峰价格的平抑作用仍具有时段差异。

2025年7月广东迎峰度夏进入主段：全省电网检修条数日均约32条，检修容量日均约5670MW，500kV、220kV检修条数分别约7条和25条。进入2026年后，4月春检强度显著高于去年同期，4月检修条数均值约116条、检修容量均值约22580MW；5月容量侧明显回落至约7890MW，6月截至6月18日进一步降至约5720MW，最近7天约7100MW。检修条数6月截至6月18日均值约56条，最近7天约60条，仍高于2025年7月基准；500kV和220kV最近7天分别约10条和50条。

因此，2026年7月检修侧不宜简单沿用4月春检高压状态，也不能完全按低检修月份处理。更合理的判断是：机组容量检修较4月明显缓和，容量中枢大概率接近或略高于2025年7月；但输变电检修条数仍明显高于2025年7月，局部网架约束和高负荷日晚峰仍可能放大现货价格波动。对7月电价的影响应表述为“容量侧较春检缓和、网络侧扰动仍在”，主要体现在工作日晚峰和高温负荷日。

###  I. Weather Forecast

#### National Summer and July Climate Forecast

The average temperature across Guangdong Province in July is expected to be approximately 27.0℃, showing a significant increase compared to June (25.5℃). Affected by the alternation of the subtropical high pressure and the summer monsoon, the province has entered a typical summer climate pattern. In terms of precipitation, there is expected to be one prolonged systematic precipitation process within the month. Although it has a short-term cooling effect, the high humidity environment before and after the precipitation will significantly increase the perceived temperature. 

**Zhongguancun Region:** Located in the core area of high temperatures (with an average monthly temperature of about 28℃), although the coastal areas have stronger wind speeds which help dissipate heat, the high-density building complexes will limit the cooling effect. At the same time, the precipitation is slightly more than that of the previous month, presenting a distinct "sweating day" characteristic. 

**Western Guangdong:** The average monthly temperature in places like Zhanjiang is expected to exceed 29℃, making it the hottest area in the province. The cooling load is expected to experience a sudden increase. Although the wind speed along the coast is relatively high, it has limited effect in reducing the peak electricity demand caused by extreme high temperatures. 

**Eastern Guangdong:** The temperature is relatively high, and influenced by the water vapor transport from the South China Sea, the precipitation is more than that of the previous month. This high-temperature and high-humidity environment leads to a double increase in energy consumption for air conditioning dehumidification and cooling. 

**Northern Guangdong:** The temperature is significantly lower than in other areas (25-26℃), precipitation has decreased noticeably compared to last month, and the load remains relatively stable.

### II. Load Regulation and Dispatching

Based on the historical relationship between weather and load, it is predicted that the average monthly load of the entire province under unified dispatch in July 2026 will be between 122,000 MW and 131,000 MW, showing a further increase compared to June.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg29_260702144003A381.webp)
Scatter plot of the unified dispatch load in May-July 2025 and various meteorological factors (shadows represent 95% confidence interval)

From the perspective of meteorological conditions, in July 2026, the entire province will transition from the warm and humid conditions observed in the previous period to a typical summer mode. Under this background, the cooling load will shift from a gradual release in the early stage to a concentrated outbreak. Especially in the western Pearl River Delta and the Pearl River Delta regions, temperature-sensitive loads will make a significant contribution to the total load. At the same time, the high humidity environment brought by the continuous precipitation throughout the month will significantly delay the cooling of human sensory perception, resulting in a slow reduction of cooling load at night, thereby significantly raising the load baseline over a larger time scale. Although the wind speed in coastal areas has increased, the overall wind speed is still relatively small, and it is difficult to counteract the load increment caused by high temperature and high humidity.

### III. Eastward Power Transmission

From January to June in 2026, the total power transmission volume of Xidian Power Grid showed a steady upward trend. From January to March, during the dry season, the transmission volume fluctuated and rose, always higher than the level in the same period of 2025; after March, it entered a continuous climbing stage, with the peak reaching over 30,000 MW in May; after the start of the flood season in June, with the arrival of the main flood period in South China and an increase in heavy rainfall events in the Pearl River Basin, the upstream water supply significantly increased, and the peak further rose to around 35,000 MW. During the entire month, the central value shifted upward to the range of 25,000 - 32,000 MW. In July, the main flood period in South China entered its peak stage, and the water supply in the Pearl River Basin and upstream maintained a relatively abundant situation. The hydropower output had the conditions for full generation and further release. The water supply volume was expected to maintain a phased high level operation. Coupled with the scheduling of reservoirs in the basin and the utilization of cross-regional channels, it was predicted that the central value of the total power transmission volume from Xidian to Guangdong in the entire month would be approximately 3% - 8% higher than that in the same period of 2025 (35,000 - 40,000 MW). In July, the power transmission from Xidian to Guangdong would change from "high and strong, with intermittent peaks" in June to "high and strong, continuously increasing", exerting a stronger and more sustained pressure on the daytime and off-peak electricity prices in Guangdong; however, under the pressure of extreme high-temperature load and late peak climbing, the suppression effect on peak prices still had time differences.

### IV. Maintenance of the units and power transmission and transformation equipment

In July 2025, the peak load control period in Guangdong Province began: The number of power grid maintenance operations per day across the province was approximately 32, and the maintenance capacity per day was approximately 5670 MW. The number of 500 kV and 220 kV maintenance operations was approximately 7 and 25 respectively. After entering 2026, the intensity of the spring inspection in April was significantly higher than that of the same period last year. The average number of maintenance operations in April was approximately 116, and the average maintenance capacity was approximately 22580 MW; in May, the capacity side significantly dropped to approximately 7890 MW, and by June 18, it further decreased to approximately 5720 MW. In the last 7 days, it was approximately 7100 MW. As of June 18, the average number of maintenance operations in June was approximately 56, and in the last 7 days, it was approximately 60, still higher than the benchmark of July 2025; in the last 7 days, the number of 500 kV and 220 kV maintenance operations was approximately 10 and 50 respectively. 

Therefore, for the July maintenance period in 2026, it is not appropriate to simply follow the high-voltage state of the April spring inspection, nor can it be completely handled as if it were in a low-maintenance month. A more reasonable judgment is as follows: The capacity maintenance in July is significantly less intense compared to April, and the capacity center is likely to be close to or slightly higher than that of July 2025; however, the number of transmission and transformation maintenance still significantly exceeds that of July 2025, and local network constraints and high-load evening peaks may still amplify the price fluctuation of the spot market. The impact on the July electricity price should be expressed as "the capacity side is relatively relaxed compared to the spring inspection, while the network side disturbance still exists", mainly manifested in the evening peak work days and hot load days.

### V. Trends of Primary Energy Prices

In July 2025, the average price of 5500K coal in South China was approximately 725 yuan per ton, and the average price of natural gas was about 5093 yuan per ton. In 2026, the year-on-year position on the fuel side was significantly higher: The coal price remained at 765 yuan per ton from April to June, up to June 18th, compared to the average value in July 2025, it was about 40 yuan per ton higher; The natural gas price rose from an average of about 5775 yuan per ton in April and about 6399 yuan per ton in May to an average of about 6673 yuan per ton from June 1st to 18th, and the latest value was about 6680 yuan per ton, which was about 31% higher than the average value in July 2025. 

Based on this analysis, the constraint of the primary energy price on electricity prices in July 2026 is stronger than that in July 2025. Currently, the coal price has not shown a continued upward trend. In July, it can be handled in a range around 765 yuan/ton, mainly raising the bottom cost of coal-fired power plants but not constituting a new accelerating factor; the natural gas price is already at a significantly high level. If it remains at around 6600 yuan/ton in July, it will continue to support the marginal quotations of gas power generation, especially limiting the downward space of prices during the late peak hours from 18 to 22. Overall, in July, the fuel side is in a structure of "stable coal price and high natural gas price support", which has a neutral-to-strong upward impact on the monthly average price and is a more direct upward risk source for peak and late peak prices.

## Electricity price forecast

The current spot market is expected to average approximately 408 yuan per megawatt-hour per day (monthly average center, with the daily median being approximately 419 yuan). The daily fluctuation range is 360 to 435 yuan per megawatt-hour. The average value during the evening peak period (18-22 hours) is about 493 yuan per megawatt-hour, with the highest reaching 574 yuan, which is consistent with the load increase during peak summer and the structure of the evening peak. The average daily value on working days (about 416 yuan) is higher than that on weekends (about 385 yuan). The average settlement price of the spot market in July is expected to remain within the range of 390 to 430 yuan per megawatt-hour, which is lower than the average value as of June 18th (about 457 yuan) up to June. However, it is approximately +29% compared to July 2025 (about 315 yuan), mainly reflecting the load during the hot season, the tail end of maintenance, and the cost of fuel. The upward space is still constrained by the high penetration rate of new energy, which lowers the marginal cost during the daytime. The 80% confidence interval (P10-P90) for the monthly average is [188, 658] yuan per megawatt-hour, with a wide range, reflecting the uncertainty under structural events one month in advance and should be regarded as "reference reliability" rather than strict guarantee. 

Based on the hourly prediction curve, the estimated strategy electricity prices for the typical day of July from 00:00 to 23:00 are as follows. The neutral strategy corresponds to normal weather conditions and normal power transmission and reception, with an average of approximately 408 yuan per megawatt-hour; the aggressive strategy corresponds to scenarios of continuous high temperatures, typhoon disturbances, reduced photovoltaic output due to rainfall, late peak ramp-up or local constraints being amplified, with an average of approximately 430 yuan per megawatt-hour. In terms of the curve structure, there is a relatively low level from 10 to 12 o'clock and during the noon when the output of new energy is suppressed, and the main risk premium is formed from 19 to 22 o'clock due to the load ramp-up and the marginal offer of gas power.

Quarterly forecast and production-sales synergy alerts 

To further meet the requirements of production and sales coordination and the arrangement of maintenance plans, the July forecast does not recommend setting a rigid daily price. However, it can be judged in layers based on the characteristics of working days, weekends, high temperatures, and typhoon disturbances in the first half, middle half, and second half of the month. Overall, the price center on working days is higher than that on weekends, and the main difference lies in the evening peak from 17:00 to 22:00; from 10:00 to 16:00, due to the influence of wind and solar power output and the incoming power from the west, it is still a relatively low-price period. 

Looking at the quarters, in the first quarter, the load entered the climbing stage for the peak summer period, and the price was slightly higher than the monthly average; in the second quarter, affected by possible rainfall, the peripheral circulation of typhoons, and weekend factors, the price was at the lowest point of the three quarters; in the third quarter, the accumulation of high temperatures and humidity, the resumption of production on working days, and the uncertainty of temporary maintenance all combined, making the upward risk of the evening peak more concentrated.

### 2.1 Long-Term Trading Analysis

#### Analysis of spot market operation from January to June in 2026 and reference for long-term contract pricing in July

(1) Monthly Operation Review for January to June 2026
The average spot settlement price for the months of January to June in 2026: January 324 yuan (year-on-year +7%), February 248 yuan (-28%), March 346 yuan (-2%), April 507 yuan (+48%), May 401 yuan (+24%), and as of June 18th, approximately 457 yuan. The fluctuations were driven by a combination of factors such as the entry of new energy into the market, seasonal load, the Spring Festival holiday, the intensity of maintenance, and the peak load during the summer season; among them, from late March to early April, the first round of high-price fluctuations after the entry of new energy, combined with maintenance and load factors, led to a significant increase in the average monthly price in April, and it remained in a relatively high range from May to June.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg39_260702145013A391.webp)
The unified settlement price monthly average of Guangdong Province - comparison between 2025 and 2026 (July is the forecast)

(2) Reference for the agreed price under the July long-term contract agreement 
Based on the predicted monthly central value of 408 yuan (with the daily median being approximately 419 yuan) and the P10-P90 range of [188, 658] yuan per megawatt-hour, the monthly proportionate monthly long-term contract transaction central value should be between 395 and 425 yuan per megawatt-hour. The working day contract is approximately 416 yuan, and the weekend contract is approximately 385 yuan. The peak load during the summer heating period and fuel costs still provide support for the evening peak. The long-term contract pricing can retain a small upward margin based on the central value.

#### 2.2 Monthly Trading Analysis - Peak, Flat, and Valley Structure

(1) Peak, Flat and Off-Peak Price Structure for the Period from January to July 2026 
Data from January to June in 2026 shows that the average price during off-peak hours is generally higher than that during peak hours. The main reason is that the current peak period includes the midday photovoltaic price reduction period from 10 to 11 o'clock, while the off-peak period includes the actual evening peak period from 19 to 21 o'clock. The prediction for July maintains this structure: the peak period is approximately 424 yuan, the off-peak period is approximately 435 yuan, and the valley period is approximately 362 yuan. The off-peak period is still slightly higher than the peak period.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg40_260702145133A392.webp)
Average monthly prices segmented by peak, flat and off-peak periods from January to July 2026 (July is a forecast)

(2) Monthly Trading Strategy Suggestions 
When signing the monthly contract, the average period contract price should be approximately equal to or slightly higher than the peak period contract price, and the off-peak period contract price ≈ peak period price - 15%. 
The option can be changed to "actual peak period (16-21 hours) / actual flat period (the rest of the daytime) / actual trough period (0-7 hours)". At this time, the premium for the evening peak is still quite significant (the average value from July 18th to 22nd is approximately 493 yuan). 
The contract period allocation should match the actual electricity consumption curve of users: industrial users (8-17 hours) should sign more peak periods and daytime flat periods; commercial users (10-22 hours) should balance peak and flat periods; general industrial and commercial users with a relatively high evening load (19-23 hours) should focus on signing evening flat periods and valley periods rollback contracts.

#### 2.3 Weekly Trading and Daily Trading

(1) Weekly price pattern 
Data during the stable period after entering the market (from November 2025 to March 19, 2026): The average daily price on working days was approximately 289 yuan, and on weekends it was about 281 yuan, with a price difference of about 8 yuan. This difference has significantly narrowed compared to before entering the market. The main difference is reflected in the evening peak (from 17 to 21): the evening peak on working days was approximately 411 yuan, and on weekends it was about 388 yuan. The midday photovoltaic price-dropping period (from 11 to 13) on working days was approximately 180 yuan, and on weekends it was about 144 yuan. This period has little relation to the strength of industrial electricity consumption. The predicted price difference in July (416 yuan on working days and 385 yuan on weekends) was approximately 30 yuan, reflecting that the load support for peak summer operation on working days is still strong.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg41_260702145247A393.webp)
Steady state period after entering the market (from 2025-11 to 2026-03-19) Weekly average price pattern and hourly-level curves within the day

(2) Weekly trading pricing reference 
For the typical week of July (excluding holidays), the weekly contract fair value center was approximately 395 - 420 yuan per megawatt-hour, slightly lower than the upper limit of the monthly contract, reflecting the precise anchoring of time reducing the uncertainty premium. If there are typhoons, consecutive high temperatures, or concentrated temporary maintenance weeks, the risk premium should be increased.

(3) Daily trading and forward spot trading 
During the monthly contract signing, the proportion of contracted electricity should be controlled within 60% - 80%, with 20% - 40% remaining for participation in the day-ahead spot market. Every afternoon, based on hourly price forecasts, maintenance plans, weather forecasts, and one's own position decisions, adjustments to the day-ahead spot market position should be made. In July, during the peak summer period, the influence of weather (temperature, precipitation, wind and solar power output) on the day-ahead price increases, and it is recommended to increase the frequency of dynamic adjustment of the day-ahead spot market position. 

#### 2.4 Retail Market

Estimated weighted average retail price for July: Large industrial users 405 - 435 yuan per megawatt-hour, commercial users 415 - 450 yuan, general industrial and commercial low-voltage users 460 - 510 yuan (including government funds and transmission and distribution prices). The retail contract risk mainly comes from the fluctuation of spot price differences: If a contract is signed at 408 yuan and the spot average price rises to 450 yuan, the total electricity volume with a 20% exposure corresponds to an increase in cost of approximately 8 yuan per megawatt-hour. The specific profit and loss depends on the monthly electricity consumption and time-of-use curve of the users. The prediction range is as wide as 470 yuan (P10 - P90), and the power selling company should control the tail risks through the exposure ratio, peak-time price limit and weekly price adjustment mechanism.

**Pricing strategy suggestion:**
- In the last week of June, the retail contract prices for July will be adjusted based on the actual prices. 
- The proportion of retail contracts and monthly long-term agreements should be controlled within 70% - 85%, with 15% - 30% remaining as an open margin. 
- For large industrial users, a hybrid contract of "base electricity price + actual spot market average price in the current month fluctuating by 30%" has been designed. The base electricity price for July is determined by referring to the actual price of the last week of June, the predicted central value for July, and the user's load curve. 
- In July, there is a high possibility of high temperatures, typhoons and uncertainties regarding temporary maintenance. It is recommended to set the exposure at the lower limit (15%-20%) and set a price cap for the evening rush hour to provide protection.

一 气象预报 全国夏季及六月气候预测 从全国尺度看，国家气候中心预计2026年主汛期（6-8月）我国东部存在南北两条多雨带，华东南部、华南等地降水偏多，全国大部地区气温接近常年同期到偏高，华北、华东、华中、华南、西南地区

### 一 气象预报

#### 全国夏季及六月气候预测

从全国尺度看，国家气候中心预计2026年主汛期（6-8月）我国东部存在南北两条多雨带，华东南部、华南等地降水偏多，全国大部地区气温接近常年同期到偏高，华北、华东、华中、华南、西南地区东部和新疆等地有阶段性高温热浪。台风方面，全年登陆或明显影响我国沿海地区的台风个数预计较常年偏多，路径主要影响华东和华南沿海，强度总体偏强。

聚焦6月，全国大部地区气温仍以接近常年同期到偏高为主。降水方面，东北地区北部、华东南部、华南大部、西南地区南部等地预计偏多，其中福建、广东西南部、广西南部、海南等地偏多2-5成。这意味着广东6月并非单一“高温行情”，而是高温、高湿、强降水和台风扰动共同作用的复合型天气背景。

#### 华南区域汛期预测

华南汛期方面，水利部研判珠江流域自5月21日起进入“龙舟水”降雨集中期。预计“龙舟水”期间珠江流域降雨总体较常年略偏多，流域东部、北部偏多1-2成，其中北江、韩江、东江偏多3-5成；流域气温持续偏高，强对流天气活跃，局地极端强降雨多发。对广东电力市场而言，强降雨一方面可能压低日间光伏出力、增加短时预测误差，另一方面也会改善流域来水条件，为水电出力和省间送电提供更强支撑。

#### 珠江流域来水及西电东送影响

珠江流域来水是6月供给侧的重要变量。当前厄尔尼诺快速发展，国家气候中心判断其有利于长江以南地区降水增强，并提示主汛期珠江流域有较重汛情。在这一背景下，随着汛期来临和极端降雨频发，珠江流域上游来水量预计明显加大，水电大发概率上升，西电东送能力和通道利用率有望进一步增强。结合西电东送边界判断，6月西电送入量中枢预计较2025年同期偏高5%-10%，运行形态由高位平稳转为高位偏强、阶段性冲高。需要注意的是，水电与西电增强对电价形成更强下压和稳定作用，但高温负荷、晚峰爬坡和局部网架约束仍可能推动价格阶段性冲高。

在上述全国及流域背景下，**广东本地气象预测如下：**
6月广东省平均温度约25.5℃，较5月（25.2℃）略有上升。受厄尔尼诺影响，夏季高温提前，午间可能出现极端高温天气。降水方面，预计有两次明显降水过程，较常年偏多，粤北降水量较大（月均10-13mm）。
**区域影响如下：**
珠三角：高温（月均>26℃）叠加高湿，空调负荷基线明显抬升，风力弱，调节作用有限。

粤西：湛江等地月均温超28℃，制冷负荷爆发式增长；沿海风速略强但贡献有限。

粤东：气温较高，降水适中，高湿环境推高空调能耗。

粤北：气温相对温和（23-25℃），但强降水频繁，白昼照度骤降引发照明负荷突增，雨后高湿亦抬升空调需求。

### 二 统调负荷方面

基于气象与负荷的历史关系，预计2026年6月全省统调月均负荷预计在10.8万MW至11.9万MW之间，较5月进一步增长。其中，10.8万MW至11.9万MW可作为80%置信区间（P10-P90）参考，预测中位数约11.35万MW，四分位区间（P25-P75）约11.05万MW至11.65万MW。该区间反映出在偏暖、高湿和降水偏多背景下，制冷负荷中枢上移的确定性较强，但强降水、台风扰动、风光出力及生产节奏变化仍会带来一定不确定性。

从气象条件演变来看，2026年6月整体呈现出偏暖特征，在此背景下，制冷类用电需求预计将逐步释放，并对负荷形成持续支撑。同时，降水偏多叠加高湿环境，有利于维持较高体感温度，使得空调等负荷在较长时间尺度内保持较高运行水平，从而在一定程度上抬升负荷基线。风速虽有所增强，但由于其与负荷的统计相关性较弱，对整体负荷变化的调节作用相对有限，更多体现为局地或短时波动层面的影响。

### 三 西电东送方面

2026年1-5月西电送量整体呈稳步抬升趋势。1-3月枯水期波动上行，始终高于2025年同期水平，3月后进入持续爬坡阶段，5月峰值突破30000MW，整体中枢维持在16000-25000MW区间。6月已进入丰水期，随着华南主汛期来临，珠江流域极端强降雨过程增多，上游来水量明显加大，水电出力具备进一步释放条件。根据2026年最新气候预测，华南大部、广东及珠江流域相关区域降水偏多，来水量预计迎来阶段性大幅抬升；叠加流域水库调度和跨区通道利用提升，预计全月西电送入量中枢较2025年同期偏高约5%-10%。因此，6月西电东送将由此前“高位平稳”上修为“高位偏强、阶段性冲高”，对广东日间及平段电价形成更强压制，但在高温负荷和晚峰爬坡压力下，对尖峰价格的平抑作用仍具有时段差异。

![](/media/news/hyzxImg15_260701162613A291.webp)

### 四 机组和输变电检修情况

2025年6月广东检修处在相对温和水平：全省电网检修条数日均约54条，检修容量日均约9540MW，500kV、220kV检修条数分别约14条和39条。进入2026年后，3-4月春检强度显著高于去年同期，3月和4月检修条数均值分别约105条、116条，检修容量均值分别约22980MW、22580MW；到5月以后容量侧明显回落，截至5月24日，5月检修容量均值降至约9280MW，最近7天进一步降至约6310MW，但检修条数仍维持在约95条，500kV和220kV最近7天分别约19条、77条。

因此，2026年6月检修侧不应再按4月高压状态外推。更合理的判断是：机组容量检修进入迎峰度夏前收尾阶段，容量中枢大概率回落至6000~10000MW区间，接近或略低于2025年6月均值；但输变电检修条数仍明显高于2025年6月，局部网架约束和晚高峰备用压力仍可能放大现货价格波动。对6月电价的影响应表述为“容量侧支撑减弱、网络侧扰动仍在”，主要体现在工作日晚峰和高负荷日，不宜把4月极端高价直接平移到6月。

### 五 一次能源价格走势

2025年6月华南5500K煤价整体平稳，月均约722元/吨，区间约720~725元/吨；广东天然气价格月均约4977元/吨，月内从4802元/吨附近抬升至5068元/吨。2026年燃料侧的同比位置明显更高：煤价3-5月均维持在765元/吨，较2025年6月均值高约43元/吨；天然气价格从2026年3月均值约5019元/吨、4月约5775元/吨，上行到5月1-24日均值约6233元/吨，最新值6349元/吨，较2025年6月均值高约28%。

据此判断，2026年6月一次能源价格对电价的约束强于2025年6月。煤价当前没有继续上行斜率，6月可按765元/吨附近横盘处理，主要抬高燃煤机组成本底部但不构成新增加速项；天然气价格已经处于明显高位，若6月维持在6200~6500元/吨附近，将继续支撑气电边际报价，尤其限制18-22时晚高峰价格下行空间。综合看，6月燃料侧为“煤价平稳、气价高位支撑”的结构，对月均价格是中性偏上影响，对尖峰和晚峰价格是更直接的上行风险来源。

## 电价预测

综合负荷、来水、西电送入、检修和燃料成本边界判断，6月广东现货价格预计呈现“月均中枢小幅上移、日内峰谷分化加深、晚峰风险溢价突出”的运行特征。高温高湿将持续抬升制冷负荷基线，气电边际报价和局部网架约束对18-22时晚高峰形成价格支撑；同时，汛期来水改善、水电大发和西电送入增强将压制10-16时日间价格。交易层面，6月中性策略宜以390元/兆瓦时作为小时曲线均值锚，激进策略可按410元/兆瓦时作为高波动情景均值锚，通过日内曲线而非单一均价管理敞口。核心操作思路是：午间低价窗口控制采购节奏，晚峰高价时段提前锁定风险边界。

基于上述整体判断，并参考日内价格变化率形态，对6月典型日00:00-23:00策略电价进行重新估算如下。中性策略对应常规天气和正常送受电条件，日均为390.00元/兆瓦时；激进策略对应持续高温、降雨压制光伏出力、晚峰爬坡或局部约束放大的上行情景，日均为410.00元/兆瓦时。曲线结构上，10-16时受光伏、水电和西电送入压制形成日内低谷，19-22时受负荷爬坡和气电边际报价影响形成主要风险溢价。

### 2.1中长期交易分析

**2.1.1 2026年1-5月现货运行分析与6月长协定价参考**
（1）2026年1-5月月度运行复盘
2026年1-5月现货月均结算价：1月324元（同比+7%），2月248元（-28%），3月346元（-2%），4月507元（+48%），5月368元（+14%）。波动由新能源入市、季节性负荷、春节假期、检修密集度四因素叠加驱动；其中4月（3/20-4/7）影响显著冲高，5月回落至中枢附近

（2）6月长协合约定价参考
基于预测月度中枢377元（逐日中位数约390元）和P10-P90区间[170, 765]元/兆瓦时，全月等比例月度长协成交中枢应在365-395元/兆瓦时。工作日合约约388元，周末约348元。检修季供给收紧对晚高峰有支撑，长协定价可在中枢基础上保留小幅上行预留。

**2.2月度交易分析-峰平谷结构**

（1）2026年1-6月峰平谷价格结构
2026年1-5月数据显示：平段均价多数月高于峰段均价（例如2月平段276 vs 峰段201，5月平段387 vs 峰段355）。根本原因是现行峰段包含10-11时午间光伏压价时段，而平段包含19-21时真正晚高峰。6月预测延续此结构：峰段约376元、平段约401元、谷段约352元，平段仍略高于峰段。

![](/media/news/hyzxImg22_260701163156A298.webp)
2026年1-6月峰平谷分段月均价（6月为预测）

（2）月度交易策略建议
签订月度合约时，平段合约价应约等于或略高于峰段合约价，谷段合约价≈峰段价-6%。
可协商改用“实际峰段（16-21时）/实际平段（其余日间）/实际谷段（0-7时）”，此时峰段溢价约100-150元/兆瓦时（6月晚峰均值约477元、午间约313元）。
合约时段配比应与用户实际用电曲线匹配：工业用户（8-17时）多签峰段和日间平段；商业用户（10-22时）兼顾峰平两段；居民用户（19-23时）重点签晚间平段和谷段回档合约。

Forecast of market boundary conditions in Guangdong Province for June

### I. Weather Forecast

**National Summer and June Climate Forecast**

From a national perspective, the National Climate Center predicts that during the main rainy season (June to August) in 2026, there will be two rainy zones in the eastern part of China, with excessive rainfall in the southeastern and southern parts of China. The temperatures across most of the country will be close to or higher than the average for the same period of the previous year. There will be intermittent periods of high temperatures and heat waves in the northern, eastern, central, southern, eastern and central-western parts of China, as well as in Xinjiang. Regarding typhoons, the number of typhoons that make landfall or have a significant impact on the coastal areas of China is expected to be more than usual for the year, with their paths mainly affecting the coastal areas of eastern and southern China, and their intensity is generally stronger. 

In June, the temperatures across most parts of the country remained close to or higher than the average for the same period of the previous year. Regarding precipitation, areas such as the northern part of Northeast China, the southeast of China, most of South China, and the southern part of Southwest China are expected to have above-average rainfall. Specifically, regions like Fujian, southern Guangdong, southern Guangxi, and Hainan are expected to have an increase of 20% to 50% in rainfall. This indicates that June in Guangdong is not a single "high-temperature" period, but rather a complex weather background involving high temperatures, high humidity, heavy precipitation, and the influence of typhoons.

**Flood Season Prediction for the South China Region**

Regarding the flood season in South China, the Ministry of Water Resources has assessed that the Pearl River Basin will enter a concentrated rainfall period of "Dragon Boat Rain" starting from May 21st. It is expected that during the "Dragon Boat Rain" period, the rainfall in the Pearl River Basin will be slightly more than the average in recent years. The eastern and northern parts of the basin will have an increase of 1-2 times, while the Nanjiang, Hanjiang and Dongjiang will have an increase of 3-5 times. The temperature in the basin will remain high, and there will be active strong convective weather, with frequent occurrences of extreme heavy rainfall in some areas. For the power market in Guangdong, the heavy rainfall may, on the one hand, reduce the daytime photovoltaic output and increase short-term prediction errors, and on the other hand, it will improve the water inflow conditions in the basin, providing stronger support for hydropower output and inter-provincial power transmission.

**Influences of water inflow in the Pearl River Basin and the West-to-East Power Transmission Project**

The water inflow from the Pearl River Basin is a crucial variable in the supply side in June. Currently, the El Niño phenomenon is developing rapidly, and the National Climate Center has determined that it will lead to increased precipitation in the areas south of the Yangtze River, and has warned that there will be a relatively severe flood situation in the Pearl River Basin during the main flood season. Against this backdrop, as the flood season approaches and extreme rainfall occurs frequently, the inflow of water from the upper reaches of the Pearl River Basin is expected to significantly increase, the probability of large-scale hydropower generation is expected to rise, and the capacity for power transmission from the west to the east and the utilization rate of transmission channels are expected to further enhance. Based on the judgment of the boundary for power transmission from the west to the east, the central value of the power transmission from the west to the east in June is expected to be 5% - 10% higher than that in the same period of 2025. The operating pattern is expected to shift from a high level of stability to a high level of strength and periodic surges. It should be noted that the strengthening of hydropower and power transmission from the west to the east will have a stronger downward pressure and stabilizing effect on electricity prices, but high temperatures, late peak load climbing, and local grid constraints may still push prices to surge periodically.

Under the above national and basin-wide circumstances, **the local weather forecast in Guangdong is as follows:** 
In June, the average temperature in Guangdong Province was approximately 25.5℃, slightly higher than that in May (25.2℃). Affected by El Niño, the summer heat arrived earlier, and extreme high temperatures might occur during the midday. Regarding precipitation, there are expected to be two significant rainfall events, which are more than the usual amount. The rainfall in northern Guangdong is particularly heavy (averaging 10-13mm per month). 
**The regional impact is as follows:** 
Zhuhai River Delta: High temperatures (average monthly temperature > 26℃) combined with high humidity have significantly increased the baseline load of air conditioners. The wind is weak, and the regulating effect is limited. 

Western Guangdong: The average monthly temperature in places like Zhanjiang exceeds 28℃, resulting in an explosive increase in cooling load; the wind speed along the coast is slightly stronger but its contribution is limited. 

Eastern Guangdong: The temperature is relatively high, the precipitation is moderate, and the high humidity environment increases the energy consumption of air conditioners. 

Northern Guangdong: The temperature is relatively mild (23-25℃), but there is frequent heavy precipitation. The sudden drop in daylight illumination leads to a sharp increase in lighting load, and the high humidity after the rain also raises the demand for air conditioning.

### II. Load Regulation and Dispatching

Based on the historical relationship between meteorological conditions and load, it is predicted that the average monthly load of the entire province under unified dispatch in June 2026 will be between 108,000 MW and 119,000 MW, showing a further increase compared to May. Among them, the range of 108,000 MW to 119,000 MW can be used as the 80% confidence interval (P10-P90), with a predicted median of approximately 113,500 MW and a quartile range (P25-P75) of approximately 110,500 MW to 116,500 MW. This range reflects a relatively high certainty of the central point of cooling load moving upward under the background of warmer temperatures, higher humidity, and more precipitation, but strong precipitation, typhoon disturbances, changes in wind and solar power output, and production rhythm variations will still bring certain uncertainties.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg6_260701164959A305.webp)

From the perspective of the evolution of meteorological conditions, the overall situation in June 2026 was characterized by a warmer trend. Under this backdrop, the demand for cooling-type electricity is expected to gradually be released and will provide continuous support to the load. At the same time, the increased precipitation combined with a high-humidity environment is conducive to maintaining a relatively high perceived temperature, enabling loads such as air conditioners to maintain a relatively high operating level over a longer time scale, thereby slightly raising the load baseline. Although wind speed has increased, due to its relatively weak statistical correlation with the load, its regulatory effect on the overall load change is relatively limited, and it mainly manifests as local or short-term fluctuations.

### III. Eastward Power Transmission

From January to May in 2026, the total power transmission volume of Xidian Power Grid showed a steady upward trend. From January to March, during the dry season, the transmission volume fluctuated and rose, consistently higher than the level in the same period of 2025. After March, it entered a continuous climbing stage, and in May, the peak exceeded 30,000 MW. The overall central value remained within the range of 16,000 - 25,000 MW. In June, it has entered the rainy season. With the arrival of the main flood season in South China and an increase in extreme heavy rainfall events in the Pearl River Basin, the inflow from the upstream has significantly increased, and the hydropower output has the conditions for further release. According to the latest climate forecast for 2026, most of South China, Guangdong, and related areas in the Pearl River Basin have more precipitation, and the inflow is expected to experience a significant upward trend in a phased manner. Combined with the improvement of reservoir dispatch in the basin and the utilization of cross-regional channels, it is expected that the central value of the total power transmission volume from Xidian to the east in the entire month will be approximately 5% - 10% higher than that in the same period of 2025. Therefore, the power transmission from Xidian to the east in June will be upgraded from "high level and stable" to "high level and relatively strong, with periodic peaks", exerting a stronger suppression on the daytime and off-peak electricity prices in Guangdong. However, under the pressure of high-temperature load and late peak climbing, the suppression effect on peak prices still has time differences.

### IV. Maintenance of the units and power transmission and transformation equipment

In June 2025, the maintenance activities in Guangdong Province were at a relatively moderate level: the average number of maintenance operations per day across the province was approximately 54, and the average maintenance capacity was approximately 9,540 MW. The number of 500 kV and 220 kV maintenance operations was approximately 14 and 39 respectively. After entering 2026, the intensity of the spring maintenance in March and April was significantly higher than that of the same period last year. The average number of maintenance operations in March and April was approximately 105 and 116 respectively, and the average maintenance capacity was approximately 22,980 MW and 22,580 MW respectively. After May, the capacity side showed a significant decline. As of May 24th, the average maintenance capacity in May dropped to approximately 9,280 MW, and further decreased to approximately 6,310 MW in the last 7 days. However, the number of maintenance operations remained at approximately 95, with 500 kV and 220 kV having approximately 19 and 77 operations respectively in the last 7 days. 

Therefore, for the maintenance period in June 2026, the high-pressure condition in April should no longer be extrapolated. A more reasonable judgment is as follows: The capacity maintenance of the unit enters the final stage before the peak summer period, and the capacity center is likely to fall back to the range of 6000-10000 MW, close to or slightly lower than the average value in June 2025; However, the number of maintenance projects for transmission and transformation still significantly exceeds that in June 2025, and local network constraints and late peak backup pressure may still amplify the fluctuations in spot prices. The impact on the electricity price in June should be expressed as "support on the capacity side weakening, disturbances on the network side still exist", mainly manifested in weekday peak hours and high-load days. It is not appropriate to directly transfer the extreme high prices in April to June.

### V. Trends of Primary Energy Prices

In June 2025, the overall coal price in South China was stable at approximately 722 yuan per ton, with a range of 720 to 725 yuan per ton. The average natural gas price in Guangdong was about 4977 yuan per ton, rising from around 4802 yuan per ton in the month to 5068 yuan per ton. In 2026, the year-on-year position on the fuel side was significantly higher: the coal price remained at 765 yuan per ton from March to May, about 43 yuan per ton higher than the average in June 2025; the natural gas price rose from approximately 5019 yuan per ton in March and about 5775 yuan per ton in April to an average of about 6233 yuan per ton from March 1st to 24th of 2026, with the latest value being 6349 yuan per ton, which was about 28% higher than the average in June 2025. 

Based on this analysis, the constraint of primary energy prices on electricity prices in June 2026 is stronger than that in June 2025. Currently, the coal price has not shown a continued upward trend. In June, it can be handled in a range of around 765 yuan/ton, mainly raising the bottom cost of coal-fired power plants but not constituting a new accelerating factor; the natural gas price is already at a significantly high level. If it remains at around 6200-6500 yuan/ton in June, it will continue to support the marginal quotations of gas power generation, especially limiting the downward space of prices during the late peak hours from 18 to 22. Overall, in June, the fuel side is in a structure of "stable coal prices and high natural gas prices providing support", which has a neutral-to-strong upward impact on the monthly average price and is a more direct upward risk source for peak and late peak prices.

## Electricity price forecast

Based on the comprehensive assessment of load, water inflow, power supply from the west, maintenance, and fuel costs, the expected operating characteristics of the spot price in Guangdong in June are characterized by "a slight upward movement of the monthly average center, a deeper differentiation between peaks and troughs within the day, and a prominent risk premium for the late peak". The high temperature and high humidity will continuously increase the baseline of cooling load, and the marginal quotations of gas power and local grid constraints will provide price support for the late peak from 18 to 22; at the same time, the improvement of water inflow during the flood season, the large-scale generation of hydropower, and the enhancement of power supply from the west will suppress the daytime price from 10 to 16. At the trading level, in the middle of June, a neutral strategy is advisable to use 390 yuan per megawatt-hour as the anchor for the hourly curve average, and an aggressive strategy can use 410 yuan per megawatt-hour as the anchor for the average value of the high volatility scenario. Through the daily curve rather than a single average price, the exposure can be managed. The core operation idea is: control the procurement rhythm during the low-price window in the afternoon, and lock the risk boundary in advance during the high-price period in the late peak. 

Based on the above overall judgment and referring to the price change rate pattern over the day, the strategy electricity prices for the typical days in June from 00:00 to 23:00 have been re-estimated as follows. The neutral strategy corresponds to normal weather conditions and normal power transmission and reception, with an average of 390.00 yuan per megawatt-hour per day; the aggressive strategy corresponds to scenarios of continuous high temperatures, suppression of photovoltaic output by rainfall, late peak ramp-up or amplification of local constraints, with an average of 410.00 yuan per megawatt-hour per day. In terms of the curve structure, from 10 to 16, due to the suppression of photovoltaic, hydropower and western power transmission, there is an intraday low point; from 19 to 22, it is influenced by load ramp-up and marginal quotations of gas power, forming the main risk premium.

### 2.1 Long-Term Trading Analysis

#### 2.1.1 Analysis of Spot Market Operations from January to May 2026 and Reference for Long-Term Contract Pricing in June

The fluctuations were driven by four factors: the entry of new energy, seasonal load, the Spring Festival holiday, and the intensity of maintenance; among them, April (March 20 - April 7) saw a significant upward trend, and then it returned to the middle range in May.

(2) Reference for the agreed price under the June long-term contract agreement 
Based on the predicted monthly central value of 377 yuan (with the daily median being approximately 390 yuan) and the P10-P90 range of [170, 765] yuan per megawatt-hour, the monthly proportionate monthly long-term contract transaction central value should be between 365 and 395 yuan per megawatt-hour. The working day contract is approximately 388 yuan, and the weekend contract is approximately 348 yuan. The supply tightening during the maintenance season provides support for the evening peak, and the long-term contract pricing can retain a small upward margin based on the central value.

**2.2 Monthly Trading Analysis - Peak, Flat, and Valley Structure**

(1) Peak, Flat and Off-Peak Price Structure for the Period from January to June 2026 
Data from January to May in 2026 shows that the average price during off-peak hours is generally higher than that during peak hours (for example, in February, the off-peak price was 276 while the peak price was 201, and in May, the off-peak price was 387 while the peak price was 355). The fundamental reason is that the current peak period includes the midday photovoltaic price reduction period from 10 to 11, while the off-peak period includes the real evening peak period from 19 to 21. The prediction for June maintains this structure: the peak period is approximately 376 yuan, the off-peak period is approximately 401 yuan, and the valley period is approximately 352 yuan. The off-peak period is still slightly higher than the peak period.

(2) Monthly Trading Strategy Suggestions 
When signing the monthly contract, the average period contract price should be approximately equal to or slightly higher than the peak period contract price, and the off-peak period contract price ≈ peak period price - 6%. 
It can be negotiated to switch to "actual peak period (16-21 hours) / actual flat period (the rest of the daytime) / actual valley period (0-7 hours)". At this time, the premium for the peak period is approximately 100-150 yuan per megawatt-hour (the average value of the late peak period in June is about 477 yuan, and about 313 yuan during the noon). 
The contract period allocation should match the actual electricity consumption curve of users: industrial users (8-17 hours) should sign for peak periods and daytime flat periods; commercial users (10-22 hours) should balance peak and flat periods; residential users (19-23 hours) should focus on signing for evening flat periods and off-peak periods for contract rollover.

**2.3 Weekly Trading and Daily Trading**

(1) Weekly price pattern 
Data during the stable period after entering the market (from November 2025 to March 19, 2026): The average daily price on weekdays was approximately 289 yuan, and on weekends it was about 281 yuan, with a price difference of about 8 yuan. This difference has significantly narrowed compared to before entering the market. The main difference is reflected in the evening peak (from 17 to 21): the evening peak on weekdays was approximately 411 yuan, and on weekends it was about 388 yuan. The midday photovoltaic price reduction period (from 11 to 13) on weekdays was approximately 180 yuan, and on weekends it was about 144 yuan. This period has little relation to the strength of industrial electricity consumption. The prediction for June continues this pattern, with a price difference of approximately 40 yuan between weekdays (388 yuan) and weekends (348 yuan), which is slightly larger than the stable period, reflecting the increase in workday load as summer approaches.

(2) Weekly trading pricing reference 
The typical weekly (non-holiday) contract fair price range for June is approximately 365 - 385 yuan per megawatt-hour, slightly lower than the monthly contract, reflecting the precise anchoring of time reducing the uncertainty premium. During the Dragon Boat Festival holiday week (around June 19 - 21), the price is usually slightly lower than on working days, and the contract fair price range can be lowered by 10 - 20 yuan.

(3) Daily trading and forward spot trading 
During the monthly contract signing, the proportion of contracted electricity should be controlled within 60% - 80%, with 20% - 40% remaining for participation in the day-ahead spot market. Every afternoon, based on hourly price forecasts, maintenance plans, weather forecasts, and one's own position decisions, adjustments to the day-ahead spot market position should be made. In June, the main rainy season and hot season arrive, and the influence of weather (temperature, precipitation, and wind power output) on the day-ahead price increases. It is recommended to increase the frequency of dynamic adjustment of the day-ahead spot market position.

**2.4 Retail Market**
Estimated weighted average retail price for June: Large industrial users 380 - 410 yuan per megawatt-hour, commercial users 390 - 420 yuan, residential users 440 - 490 yuan (including government funds and transmission and distribution prices). The retail contract risk mainly comes from the fluctuation of spot price differences: If the contract price is set at 377 yuan, and the spot price rises to 420 yuan, with a 20% exposure, the monthly loss could reach tens of millions. The prediction range is as wide as 595 yuan (P10 - P90), when the power seller retains a 20% exposure, in the worst case, the monthly additional expenditure could be 40 - 50 yuan per megawatt-hour.

**Pricing strategy suggestion:**
- In the last week of May, the retail contract prices for June will be adjusted based on the actual prices. 
- The proportion of retail contracts and monthly long-term agreements should be controlled within 70% - 85%, with 15% - 30% remaining as an open margin. 
- For large industrial users, a hybrid contract with "benchmark electricity price plus 30% fluctuation based on the average spot price in June" was designed; for commercial users, a fixed retail price combined with a weekly adjustment mechanism was adopted. 
- During the June rainy season and high-temperature period, the uncertainty is relatively high. It is recommended to set the exposure at the lower limit (15%-20%), and set a price upper limit protection for the evening rush hour.

电价预测

日前现货市场日均中位数预计约433元/兆瓦时，跨日波动范围250~500元/兆瓦时。晚高峰时段（18-22时）冲高至550~700元/兆瓦时，与近几个月表现一致。劳动节假期内价格略低于工作日。5月现货市场日均结算价预计维持在400~480元/兆瓦时区间，与4月基本持平，上行空间受制于用户侧年度长协电价下限（约0.372元/kWh）及新能源高渗透率压低日间边际成本。

### 2.1中长期交易分析

#### 2.1.1 2026年1-4月现货运行分析与5月长协定价参考

1. 2026年1-4月月度运行复盘
   2026年1-4月现货月均结算价：1月324元（同比+7%），2月248元（-28%），3月346元（-2%），4月493元（+44%）。波动由新能源入市、季节性负荷、春节假期、检修密集度四因素叠加驱动。

   ![](/media/news/hyzxImg10_260701143652A252.webp)
广东日前统一结算价月度均价—2025年vs2026年对比（5月为首版预测）

#### 2.2 月度交易分析-峰平谷结构

1. 2026年1-5月峰平谷价格结构
   2026年1-5月数据显示：平段均价多数月高于峰段均价（例如2月平段276 vs 峰段201）。根本原因是现行峰段包含10-12时午间光伏压价时段，而平段包含19-21时真正晚高峰。5月延续此结构

![](/media/news/hyzxImg11_260701143834A253.webp)
2026年1-5月峰平谷分段月均价

2. 月度交易策略建议
签订月度合约时，平段合约价应约等于或略高于峰段合约价，谷段合约价≈峰段价-10%。

可协商改用“实际峰段（16-21时）/实际平段（其余日间）/实际谷段（0-7时）”，此时峰段溢价约150-200元/兆瓦时。

合约时段配比应与用户实际用电曲线匹配：工业用户（8-17时）多签峰段和日间平段；商业用户（10-22时）兼顾峰平两段；居民用户（19-23时）重点签晚间平段和谷段回档合约。

#### 2.3 周交易与日交易

1. 周内价格模式
   工作日（周一至周五）日均价285-295元，周末275-285元，价差约10-15元，较入市前明显收窄。差异主要体现在晚峰（17-21时）：工作日晚峰400-430元，周末370-400元。午间光伏压价时段（11-13时）两者均在180-230元，与工业用电强弱基本无关。

![](/media/news/hyzxImg13_260701144003A254.webp)
入市后稳态期（2025-11至2026-03-19）周内日均价模式与日内小时级曲线

2. 周交易定价参考
   5月典型周（非假期）周度合约公允中枢约425-445元/兆瓦时，略低于月合约，反映时间锚定精确降低不确定性溢价。含劳动节周（5/1-5/8）合约中枢降至400-420元。

3. 日交易与日前现货
月度签约时控制合约电量比例在60%-80%，留20%-40%参与日前现货。每日下午需结合小时级价格预测、检修计划、气象预报及自身头寸决策。

#### 2.4 零售市场

5月零售加权均价预估：大工业用户440-470元/兆瓦时，商业用户450-480元，居民用户500-550元（含政府性基金与输配电价）。零售合约风险主要来自现货价差波动：若按430元签约，现货涨至470元，20%敞口下月亏损可达1000万元。预测区间宽达366元，售电公司保留20%敞口时，最坏情形单月多支出40-50元/兆瓦时。

**定价策略建议：**

·4月最后一周根据实际价格调整5月零售合约价。

·零售合约与月度长协比例控制在70%-85%，留15%-30%敞口。

· 针对大工业用户设计“基准电价+5月现货均价浮动30%”的混合合约；针对商业用户采用固定零售价配合每周调整机制。

整体结论

##### 市场总体特征

2026年5月广东电力市场呈现“高温高湿推高负荷、现货价格中枢平稳、峰平谷结构倒挂延续”三大特征。

##### 电价水平

预计现货日均结算价维持在400-480元/兆瓦时，与4月基本持平。午间光伏压价效应显著，晚高峰仍将出现550-700元/兆瓦时的高价。

##### 中长期交易建议

月度长协公允区间为420-460元/兆瓦时，建议市场主体控制长协比例在60%-80%，保留20%-40%现货敞口。

##### 零售侧风险

价差波动风险较大，建议零售合约与月度长协比例控制在70%-85%，并针对不同用户设计混合合约（如“基准价+浮动30%”）。

##### 需重点关注的问题

峰平谷结构错配导致平段价格反超峰段；4月高密度检修的影响将传导至5月；太阳能辐射增强将温和压低午间电价，但不会引发剧烈波动。

Forecast of market boundary conditions in Guangdong Province for May

![](/media/news/hyzxImg2_260701144623A255.webp)

### I. Meteorological Aspects
In May, the average temperature in Guangdong Province was approximately 25.2℃, significantly higher than that in April (23.7℃). Due to the influence of El Niño, the summer heat arrived earlier, and extreme high temperatures might occur during the midday. Regarding precipitation, there were three distinct precipitation events in the southern part of South China, which were more than the usual amount. The precipitation in central and eastern Guangdong was particularly heavy (averaging 8-12mm per day). The regional impacts are as follows:

- **Zhongguancun Area**
High temperatures (average monthly temperature > 25℃) combined with high humidity cause a significant increase in the baseline of air conditioning load. The wind is weak, and the regulating effect is limited.
- **Southwest Guangdong**
The average monthly temperature in places like Zhanjiang exceeds 27℃, leading to an explosive increase in cooling load; the wind speed along the coast is slightly stronger but its contribution is limited.
- **Eastern Guangdong**
The temperature is high, the precipitation is moderate, and the high humidity environment increases the energy consumption of air conditioners.
- **Guangdong North Region**
The temperature is relatively mild (ranging from 21 to 24 degrees Celsius), but there are frequent heavy rains. The sudden drop in daylight illumination leads to a sharp increase in lighting load, and the high humidity after the rain also raises the demand for air conditioning.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg3_260701145036A256.webp)

![](/media/news/hyzxImg4_260701145111A257.webp)
Spatial distribution of monthly average values of various meteorological elements in Guangdong Province in May 2026

### II. Power Prediction Aspects

Based on the month-on-month analysis of the forecast data for May and the actual results for April, the overall output of new energy in Guangdong Province showed a moderate growth trend. The forecast for May indicated that the output of wind power remained almost unchanged, with an increase in the average wind speed of about 0.1%. Solar radiation (SSRD) increased by approximately 8.5 W/m² compared to the previous month, becoming the dominant factor driving the growth. The output of new energy in May was slightly higher than that in April, with almost all of the increase coming from photovoltaic power.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg5_260701145228A258.webp)
Forecast of New Energy Output in May 2026

### III. Amplitude-Modulated Load Aspect

Based on the historical relationship between weather and load, it is predicted that the average monthly load of the entire province under unified dispatch in May 2026 will be between 101,000 MW and 108,000 MW, showing a further increase compared to April.

![](/media/news/hyzxImg6_260701145333A259.webp)
Scatter plot of the unified load in the second quarter of 2025 and various meteorological factors (shadows represent 95% confidence interval)

From the perspective of the evolution of meteorological conditions, the overall temperature in May 2026 was relatively warm. Under this background, the demand for cooling-type electricity is expected to gradually be released and will provide continuous support for the load. At the same time, the abundant precipitation combined with high humidity environment is conducive to maintaining a relatively high perceived temperature, allowing air conditioners and other loads to maintain a relatively high operating level over a long time scale, thereby slightly raising the load baseline. Although the wind speed has increased, due to its relatively weak statistical correlation with the load, its regulatory effect on the overall load change is relatively limited, and it mainly manifests as local or short-term fluctuations.

### IV West-to-East Power Transmission

In the first quarter of 2026, the power transmission volume of Xidian Electric Power increased by 13.3% year-on-year. During the winter-spring dry water period from January to March, the power transmission from Xidian to the east remained within a low-level fluctuation range, similar to that in 2025 from January to March, with the overall volume remaining stable at 10,000 - 25,000 MW. In April, the transmission trend continued the upward climb from the dry water period to the flood season, without the extreme surge seen in April 2025. In May, during the transition from the dry water period to the flood season, the transmission volume is expected to be 16,000 - 18,000 MW.

### V Maintenance Status of the Unit and Transmission & Transformation Equipment

In April 2026, the total capacity of equipment undergoing maintenance in Guangdong Province reached a historical high of over 30,000 MW, equivalent to 14% of the province's total installed capacity. This was nearly twice the level in the same period of 2025. The significant increase in maintenance intensity directly pushed up the average price for April and affected the forecast for May through the lagging price factor.

### VI Trends in Primary Energy Prices

The price of natural gas is highly sensitive to electricity prices, and gas power generation remains the marginal power generation unit in Guangdong. The fluctuation of coal prices is not obvious; the price of natural gas rose after the Spring Festival but the growth rate has slowed down recently. The following chart shows the comparison between the observed and predicted values of the comprehensive price of natural gas.
