Relevant departments (units), all commercial aerospace enterprises:
Commercial aerospace is a crucial force in driving the development of the aerospace industry and building a powerful aerospace nation. To implement the strategic deployment of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, further support, encourage, and regulate the high-quality and safe development of commercial aerospace, the National Space Administration has formulated the Action Plan for Promoting the High-Quality and Safe Development of Commercial Aerospace (2025-2027). It is hereby issued to you, please conscientiously implement it.

China National Space Administration
November 18, 2025
(This document is publicly released)

**The China National Space Administration promotes the high-quality and safe development of commercial aerospaceAction Plan (2025-2027)**

I. General Requirements

Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, we will thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 20th Central Committee. We will fully, accurately, and comprehensively apply the new development philosophy, accelerate the creation of a new development paradigm, pursue high-quality development, and ensure better integration between an effective market and a well-functioning government.We will balance development and security, incorporate commercial aerospace into the overall national aerospace development framework, and foster a policy and regulatory environment that is open, transparent, fair, and just. Efforts will be made to optimize resource allocation and improve development efficiency, advance supply-side structural reform in the aerospace sector, and improve the industrial ecosystem.We will accelerate the formation of new quality productive forces in aerospace, enhance the overall performance and effectiveness of aerospace development, and provide strong support for building China into a leading aerospace power.

Adhere to innovative thinking and enhance development momentum. Fully leverage the main innovative role of commercial aerospace enterprises, promote the deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation, support and encourage exploratory and leading technological and business model innovations. Adhere to systematic thinking and promote industrial synergy. Give full play to the decisive role of the market in resource allocation, better leverage the role of the government, strengthen systematic planning and layout across the entire industry chain, promote the deep integration of innovation chains, industry chains, capital chains, and talent chains, promote industrial cooperation, and build a good industrial ecosystem. Adhere to legal thinking to ensure safety and orderliness. Improve the policy and regulatory system, create a good business environment, safeguard the development rights and interests of commercial aerospace, strengthen safety supervision and management, and promote high-quality development and high-level safety of commercial aerospace.

By 2027, the commercial aerospace industry will achieve efficient synergy, with scientific research and production conducted safely and orderly. The industry scale will significantly expand, innovation and creativity will be significantly enhanced, resource capabilities will be comprehensively developed and efficiently utilized, and industry governance capabilities will be significantly improved. This will essentially realize high-quality development in the commercial aerospace industry.

II. Key Measures
1. Competitive access to national scientific research projects. Civil aerospace research programs and basic scientific research topics are open to commercial aerospace entities, strengthening the strategic, forward-looking, and systematic layout of basic research in commercial aerospace. Support is given to the research and development of advanced technologies such as new concepts, new products, and low-cost technologies, accelerating high-level scientific and technological self-reliance. Focusing on frontier and key technological fields such as advanced aerospace propulsion technology, advanced satellite platforms and payload technology, and integrated communication, navigation, and remote sensing applications, commercial aerospace entities are encouraged to actively participate in the development and construction of civil aerospace projects and national major special projects.
2. Promote the commercial application of national technological achievements. Improve the intellectual property system, promote the establishment of a mechanism for promoting the application of technological achievements formed by national investment to commercial aerospace entities, implement large-scale application demonstration actions for new technologies, new products, and new scenarios in commercial aerospace, explore diverse technological routes, and increase the construction and opening up of application scenarios. Encourage local governments to establish several advanced technological achievement transformation centers and service platforms, establish a mechanism for sharing technological achievements, provide preferential policies and financial support for the incubation and implementation of technological achievements in the aerospace field, promote the promotion and application of national aerospace technological achievements in the commercial aerospace field, and enhance the efficiency of national scientific and technological innovation.
3. Build a platform for aerospace technology innovation. Promote the establishment of the China Commercial Aerospace Promotion Association, encourage the rational flow of talents, and establish a cooperative innovation mechanism for industry-university-research-application cooperation that features joint development, complementary advantages, shared achievements, and shared risks. Encourage local governments to establish technological innovation centers in key areas such as reusable rockets and intelligent satellites; focus on key links such as intelligent manufacturing and final assembly testing, build public technology platforms, carry out generic technology research and development, tackle major science and technology projects, support commercial aerospace entities to accelerate technological iteration, and promote and drive the transformation of aerospace scientific research and production towards low cost and large scale.
(2) Efficient utilization of capacity resources.
4. Promote the open sharing of national scientific research and testing facilities and equipment. Improve and perfect the policies for the graded and classified open sharing and use of major scientific research and testing facilities and equipment, coordinate the relationship between an effective market and a proactive government, rely on industry strengths to build information service platforms, make good use of open sharing financial incentives and subsidies, stimulate the enthusiasm and initiative of relevant units to carry out the open sharing of facilities and equipment, and under the premise of ensuring safe use, increase the open sharing of large-scale testing facilities and equipment such as national civil telemetry and control stations, receiving stations, calibration fields, authenticity testing fields, as well as rocket engine test benches and space environment testing equipment to commercial aerospace entities.
5. Promote the coordinated construction and integrated application of ground infrastructure. Strengthen overall planning, optimize layout structure, and promote integration and fusion. Enhance the coordination of civil and commercial needs for ground infrastructure construction, promote the demonstration and construction of public service guarantee test facilities, encourage and support commercial aerospace enterprises to accelerate the construction of a number of major pilot platforms with strong industry driving force, regulate and guide the construction of infrastructure such as commercial aerospace launch tests, collaboratively promote the construction of commercial aerospace launch sites, and promote the integrated development of national infrastructure and commercial infrastructure. Establish an equal and reasonable cooperation mechanism for sharing and utilization, support state-owned enterprises, universities, and research institutes to provide market-oriented pilot services, encourage commercial aerospace facilities to participate in national aerospace engineering support and guarantee tasks, and improve the utilization efficiency of ground infrastructure.
6. Promote the integrated development of the civil and commercial aerospace standard system. Establish an authoritative, unified, open, and shared aerospace standard system. Focusing on key aspects such as commercial satellite and rocket development, launch services, telemetry and control operations, on-orbit collision avoidance, satellite data applications, and safety supervision, research and formulate relevant technical standards and specifications, clarify mandatory standards and guiding standards, and enhance the systematicness and practicality of standards in the commercial aerospace field. Promote the unification of civil and commercial aerospace standards, achieving a highly compatible, flexible, open, heterogeneous, and reconfigurable civil and commercial aerospace system architecture, as well as system interconnection and interoperability.
7. Improve the support mechanism for the construction and operation of commercial satellites. Research and formulate policies and systems for commercial satellite launch, telemetry and control, on-orbit operation management, transfer, de-orbiting, and return, establish relevant mechanism processes, and promote efficient construction and utilization of satellite resources. Make full use of state-owned and commercial monitoring facilities and space-based control systems to build and maintain a dynamic database for autonomous cataloging of space debris, carry out space debris data information sharing and application, space debris tracking and monitoring, and risk research and judgment, and support on-orbit collision warning and disposal, emergency response for commercial spacecraft. Explore the adoption of methods such as deposits and guarantees to coordinate and arrange the de-orbiting disposal and safe re-entry of commercial satellites.
8. Promote the safe and efficient utilization of satellite data. Advocate for the introduction of implementation rules that support government investment in the commercial development and utilization of data, encourage local governments to guide commercial space entities to invest in application development, and develop typical demonstration application scenarios. Promote the introduction of satellite data transmission security standards, regulate data acquisition and use, establish a commercial satellite data quality certification and compliance review system, and enhance the security protection capabilities of satellite systems and ground networks. Research standards for the classification and grading of commercial satellite data security and safety supervision mechanisms, and promote the implementation of satellite data applications. Build a trusted platform for the sharing of commercial satellite data, and promote the establishment of mechanisms for space big data sharing and trading, as well as space-based integrated data information service systems.
(III) Promote the development and growth of industries.
9. Promote the optimization of industrial structure. Encourage commercial aerospace enterprises to layout corresponding links in the aerospace industry chain, strengthen satellite and rocket manufacturing, expand application services, enhance measurement and control operation capabilities, and promote the high-quality development of the commercial aerospace industry. Prioritize supporting commercial aerospace entities in developing new technologies and products, and exploring new application scenarios. The space transportation system focuses on supporting the construction and development of low-cost, high-reliability, fast-response, and reusable commercial launch vehicles; the spacecraft system focuses on supporting the construction and development of satellite constellation systems for low-orbit communication, navigation enhancement, and high-resolution remote sensing; the launch and recovery system plans the construction of new commercial launch systems such as commercial launch sites and supporting facilities, as well as maritime launch and recovery sites; the measurement and control system focuses on supporting the establishment of an integrated layout and resource integration application for commercial measurement and control; the application system focuses on supporting the development of application scenarios and product services for mass consumer services and the international market.
10. Guide local governments to promote the development of the commercial aerospace industry. Enhance the coordination of regional development and promote coordinated regional development. Guide local governments to leverage their unique advantages in local resources, technology, talent, and industrial support, harness the agglomeration effect of industrial parks, and develop the commercial aerospace industry according to local conditions.
11. Support the expansion of new business forms. Support commercial aerospace entities in strengthening original innovation and tackling key core technologies, system development, and application services, innovating business models, and developing emerging business forms in new areas such as space resource development and utilization, space manufacturing, on-orbit maintenance and services, space environment monitoring and detection, space debris monitoring, early warning, mitigation, and removal, space tourism, and space biopharmaceuticals.
12. Guide and cultivate patient capital. Improve the investment and financing system and mechanism for the development of commercial aerospace, establish a national commercial aerospace development fund, encourage local governments, financial institutions, and social capital to jointly establish investment platforms, and guide capital to adhere to long-term investment, strategic investment, and value investment. Establish a project promotion mechanism, select a number of commercial aerospace projects that are in line with aerospace development planning and investment policy directions, have strong innovation, good demonstration, and potential for industrial development, and promote them to the fund. The fund makes independent decisions in a market-oriented manner.
13. Expand government procurement. Intensify efforts to coordinate public welfare needs across government departments, improve the government procurement service mechanism, promote the participation of commercial capabilities such as commercial carrier rockets, commercial satellites, commercial launch sites, and commercial TT&C facilities in national space missions, and encourage government departments at all levels to expand their procurement of commercial space services.
14. Facilitate international development. Encourage commercial aerospace entities to actively participate in the formulation of relevant international rules in the field of outer space. Through bilateral and multilateral cooperation channels between governments, promote the orderly expansion of commercial aerospace enterprises overseas, showcase China's commercial aerospace projects and capabilities, encourage commercial aerospace entities to participate in foreign cooperation and exchanges, and assist developing countries in developing satellite applications and other industries. Select outstanding commercial aerospace projects and incorporate them into relevant channels for international aerospace cooperation for support.
(4) Provide effective industry management and services.
15. Improve the regulatory and policy system for commercial aerospace. Accelerate the enactment of the National Aerospace Law, clarify the role and position of commercial aerospace in the development of national aerospace, and ensure the healthy and sustainable development of commercial aerospace. Expedite the introduction of relevant regulatory and policy documents in key areas such as space debris mitigation and protection, approval of specific aerospace product and technology export projects, international aerospace cooperation, aerospace launch license management, space object registration management, open sharing of space science data, protection of the moon and other celestial bodies, space traffic management, and aerospace launch site management. Promote the confirmation of property rights for assets such as carrier rockets, spacecraft, satellite data, and test equipment and facilities, and protect the rights and interests of commercial aerospace entities. Improve the market access mechanism for commercial aerospace, establish a negative list for market access, reasonably adjust relevant qualification regulations, and exempt enterprises developing commercial satellites from obtaining weapons and equipment research and production licenses. Strengthen the promotion and introduction of regulatory policies, and enhance the efficiency of government services.
16. Strengthen the overall planning for the development of commercial aerospace. Improve the communication and coordination mechanism among competent departments, continuously optimize relevant access and licensing approval processes, and meet the needs of commercial aerospace entities to flexibly respond to market demands. Coordinate the development needs of commercial aerospace, encourage enterprises to collaborate with research institutes and universities for collaborative innovation, and strengthen guidance in tackling key technologies in commercial aerospace launch vehicles, satellites, and other aspects. Optimize the spatial layout of commercial aerospace development, guide local governments and commercial aerospace entities to focus on differentiated development, and avoid low-level redundant construction.
17. Promote open collaboration in the industrial and supply chains. Continuously organize and conduct assessments on the safety and industry compliance of the aerospace industrial and supply chains, promote the establishment of an information management service system for commercial aerospace entities, comprehensively and accurately grasp the development trends and progress of commercial aerospace entities, establish scientific industry statistical standards, promote the construction of a basic database for the aerospace industrial and supply chains, and provide support for scientific management and efficient services in the industry. Further promote the open integration of the aerospace industrial and supply chains, and encourage state-owned enterprises and private enterprises to mutually integrate their advantageous supporting products into each other's supply chain systems.
18. Implement the liability for damages in commercial space activities. Establish a cross-departmental regulatory service mechanism for commercial space damage compensation, supervising and guiding the assessment and compensation of personal injury and property damage caused by launch vehicles and spacecraft during the development and testing, launch, on-orbit operation, re-entry, and other stages. Establish a compulsory insurance system for commercial space activities, implementing the liability for compensation of space object owners, launchers, operators, etc. through the purchase of third-party liability insurance and other commercial insurance for commercial space activities.
19. Guide commercial space entities to comply with international outer space rules. Strengthen the promotion and introduction of international outer space rules, guide commercial space entities to adhere to space traffic management rules, ensure that commercial space activities are legal and compliant, and proactively take effective measures focusing on rocket passivation, satellite de-orbiting, and other aspects to ensure compliance with international outer space rules and domestic management policies, promoting the sustainable development of space activities.
(5) Strengthen safety supervision across the entire supply chain.
20. Strengthen the organizational management of safety supervision. Further tighten and solidify the safety supervision responsibilities and main safety responsibilities of central, local, and enterprise levels, promote the establishment of a commercial aerospace safety supervision mechanism, and gradually establish a basic commercial aerospace safety supervision system with clear responsibilities, well-defined division of labor, effective measures, and long-term effectiveness. Formulate and introduce urgently needed safety supervision measures in areas such as testing, launching, access, and data application, gradually establish a standardized and orderly policy and institutional system, and create an industrial ecosystem and development environment that adheres to safety bottom lines and is full of innovative vitality.
21. Strengthen safety inspections throughout the entire product lifecycle. Establish a comprehensive safety inspection system that covers all elements of the entire process, including product development, testing, final assembly, testing, launch, on-orbit, de-orbit, and data application. The industry's competent department, in conjunction with relevant departments with supervisory and inspection responsibilities, conducts rigorous inspections on product quality, reliability, safety, fire safety, special equipment safety, hazardous substance safety, hazardous operation safety, road transportation safety, landing zone safety, and space safety at key stages such as product transition, factory delivery, testing, launch, and data application. For key systems or products involving significant safety risks, safety reviews and evaluations are conducted, hidden dangers are seriously rectified, and strict accountability is enforced in the event of safety accidents or serious consequences.
22. Enhance safety supervision capabilities. 为进一步鼓励支持商业气象小卫星发展，8月27日，中国气象局印发《关于促进商业气象小卫星发展与应用的指导意见》（以下简称《指导意见》）。

为什么要出台《指导意见》？气象部门将为商业航天提供哪些发展空间？商业气象小卫星又将如何与风云气象卫星协同，如何服务于气象高质量发展？带着这些问题，记者采访了中国气象局综合观测司司长方翔。


**问：《指导意见》出台背景是什么？**

答：近年来，党中央高度重视商业航天发展，多次就商业航天发展做出部署要求，相继出台一系列引导扶持政策，推动我国商业航天步入快车道。

2023年12月，中央经济工作会议提出要打造商业航天等若干战略性新兴产业。2024年3月，政府工作报告提出要积极培育新兴产业和未来产业，积极打造生物制造、商业航天、低空经济等新增长引擎。2025年3月，政府工作报告指出新培育一批国家级先进制造业集群，商业航天、北斗应用、新型储能等新兴产业快速发展；开展新技术新产品新场景大规模应用示范行动，推动商业航天、低空经济、深海科技等新兴产业安全健康发展。

党中央的决策部署为中国气象局以气象需求引导商业气象小卫星有序发展提供了根本遵循。

围绕贯彻落实习近平总书记关于气象工作和航天强国建设的重要指示批示精神，以及贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于打造商业航天新增长引擎决策部署，中国气象局充分发挥气象行业管理职能，在确保风云气象卫星持续稳定提供全球气象监测的基础上，以气象需求为牵引，以科技创新为驱动，以气象高质量发展为目标，积极探索促进商业气象小卫星与应用高质量发展环境，出台了《指导意见》。


**问：为何要支持促进商业气象小卫星发展与应用，有哪些具体考虑？**

答：核心是从“强体系”和“促发展 ”两个方面考虑。

一方面，商业气象小卫星可补充强化风云气象卫星观测能力，响应更高精度的气象服务需求。经过50年多的发展，我国已建成了综合探测性能国际先进的风云气象卫星星座，在气象业务中发挥着不可替代的作用。近年来，极端天气频发、重发，气象防灾减灾、天气预报预警对气象卫星监测的要求持续提高。商业小卫星具有机动灵活、可定制、分布式的优势，相当于给风云气象卫星配了“帮手”，协同起来进一步提升部分气象要素全球观测时空分辨率，强化灾害天气监测预警能力。目前，我国天目、云遥等国产商业掩星小卫星星座初具规模，经应用评估，其数据有效补充了风云气象卫星掩星观测能力，在数值天气预报、天气实况等气象业务中发挥了积极作用。另外还有个参考，欧美等发达国家也在积极推动气象小卫星发展，以补充大平台气象卫星观测能力。针对暴雨、热带风暴、强对流等探测需求，研制发射了COSMIC、TROPICS等多个小卫星星座，涵盖掩星探测、微波探测、光学探测、主动雷达等多种探测手段。此外还通过出台政策、建立数据采购机制，形成了一套小卫星市场化发展模式，采购了商业气象小卫星数据，这些数据在改进天气预报模型、提高全球天气预报准确性发挥了重要作用，这为我国商业气象小卫星发展和应用提供了可借鉴的成熟经验。

另一方面，要以气象需求为牵引，构建市场化良性发展机制。商业气象小卫星核心应用聚焦气象防灾减灾、数值天气预报、大气实况业务等气象专业领域，需要中国气象局把业务需求提出来，当好“指挥棒”。中国气象局已经建立了一套商业气象小卫星数据试用、评估、业务准入、推广应用的全链条管理流程，为小卫星数据推广提供了支持。同时从“风云卫星为主、小卫星辅助协同”的整体格局出发，引导商业航天企业科学合理设置载荷指标、规划星座布局、生产数据产品，从而避免重复建设，确保资源高效利用。通过需求端牵引与供给端优化的良性互动，提升国产商业气象小卫星的制造水平、应用价值和市场竞争，最终形成可持续的市场化发展机制，推动卫星应用效益落地，推动这个新兴产业健康发展。


**问：《指导意见》主要包括哪些内容？**

答：《指导意见》的内容比较丰富，主要从促进有序发展、优化数据政策、提供技术支撑、鼓励协同创新等四方面作出安排。

值得关注的，《指导意见》明确提出的持续推动风云气象卫星基本数据开放共享，加强数据资源整合，支持商业气象小卫星释放气象数据要素价值，发挥气象数据要素乘数效应，赋能经济社会高质量发展。这对商业气象小卫星企业发展有显著的示范带动意义。

在技术支撑方面，《指导意见》提出，鼓励各级气象部门开展国产商业气象小卫星应用，支持国产商业气象小卫星发展。充分利用中国气象局地面站网资源为商业气象小卫星交叉定标、数据接收处理、运行控制等提供支撑，统筹实施风云气象卫星和商业气象小卫星集约智慧运行。鼓励气象部门与商业气象小卫星企业开展联合应用攻关，强化多源卫星数据在气象业务中的深度应用。以上举措都将促进气象部门与商业航天企业间的务实合作。


**问：《指导意见》出台后，将实现什么样的愿景？**

答：《指导意见》的核心愿景是构建“风云卫星为主、商业卫星辅助”的天基气象协同观测体系，为气象高质量发展提供新动能。具体可从三方面体现：

一是提升观测能力。依托商业气象小卫星“小快灵”的优势，补充风云气象卫星观测能力，提升气象卫星观测的精细化水平。同时借助商业小卫星开展新载荷新技术在轨验证，为风云卫星载荷升级提供科技支撑。二是发展风云星座。引导商业气象小卫星企业聚焦数值天气预报等重点领域，以气象业务需求为导向，研发更贴合需求的小卫星星座，与风云卫星形成“大卫星与小卫星、综合星与专项星”协同的“风云+”星座，通过共享地面站网资源、联合攻关应用技术等方式，让商业小卫星发挥投资效益。三是赋能产业发展。推动商业气象小卫星领域科技创新、强化专业人才培养、统筹部门内外资源，形成气象需求牵引、健康有序发展、卫星数据产品深度应用的新发展格局，更好地服务于国家经济社会发展。


**问：此前，针对商业气象小卫星发展，中国气象局做了哪些工作？**

答：中国气象局一直秉承开放合作共赢理念，与国家相关部门密切沟通，与中国科学院、航天科技集团、航天科工集团以及民营企业等商业气象小卫星研制单位密切合作，共同推动商业气象小卫星发展。

除政策支持外，近年来，中国气象局还以具体举措引导商业气象小卫星发展，促进应用效益发挥。

2023年8月，中国气象局成立掩星气象探测数据应用工作专班，推进掩星气象探测数据在数值天气预报、台风监测预报、空间天气监测预报等方面的应用。同年11月，天目和云遥卫星产品入围2023年度中国气象局高价值气象数据产品。

2024年底，商业气象小卫星数据首次获准进入中国气象局业务系统，“天目一号”星座23颗卫星、“云遥一号”系列12颗卫星进入中国气象局综合气象观测系统并实现业务运行，在中国气象局数值天气预报系统中发挥了重要作用。

2025年8月，为推动国产商业气象小卫星走出国门，中国气象局与欧洲气象卫星组织（EUMETSAT）启动了国产商业气象小卫星数据在欧洲气象卫星业务和数值天气预报中的应用效果评估试验，我们也期待通过此次试验进一步提升我国商业气象小卫星数据质量和应用水平。


**问：引导促进商业气象小卫星发展，气象部门还将有哪些举措？**

答：中国气象局将一如既往引导促进商业气象小卫星发展，包括牵头成立由国家级业务单位、高等院校、科研院所、相关企业等组成的协调组织，成立高层次专家技术指导委员会，组织开展商业气象小卫星应用研讨、联合创新、专业培训。鼓励各单位在访问学者、科研立项、教育培训、评选表彰中，对商业气象小卫星专业技术人才给予支持，引导更多资源向商业气象小卫星领域集聚。
Actively promote the development and application of commercial meteorological small satellites
To further encourage and support the development of commercial meteorological small satellites, on August 27th, the China Meteorological Administration issued the "Guiding Opinions

To further encourage and support the development of commercial meteorological small satellites, on August 27th, the China Meteorological Administration issued the "Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development and Application of Commercial Meteorological Small Satellites" (hereinafter referred to as the "Guiding Opinions"). 

Why was the "Guiding Opinions" issued? What development space will the meteorological department provide for commercial aerospace? How will commercial meteorological small satellites collaborate with Fengyun meteorological satellites and how will they serve the high-quality development of meteorology? With these questions in mind, the reporter interviewed Fang Xiang, the director of the Comprehensive Observation Department of the China Meteorological Administration.


**Question: What was the background for the release of the "Guiding Opinions"?**

Answer: In recent years, the Central Committee of the Party has attached great importance to the development of commercial space industry. It has made multiple deployments and requirements regarding the development of commercial space industry, and has successively introduced a series of guiding and supportive policies to push China's commercial space industry onto a fast track.

In December 2023, the Central Economic Work Conference proposed to develop several strategic emerging industries such as commercial aerospace. In March 2024, the government work report stated that it was necessary to actively cultivate emerging industries and future industries, and actively create new growth engines such as biomanufacturing, commercial aerospace, and low-altitude economy. In March 2025, the government work report pointed out that a number of national advanced manufacturing clusters had been newly cultivated, and emerging industries such as commercial aerospace, Beidou application, and new energy storage had developed rapidly; large-scale application demonstrations of new technologies, new products, and new scenarios were carried out, and emerging industries such as commercial aerospace, low-altitude economy, and deep-sea technology were promoted to develop safely and healthily.

The decisions and instructions of the Central Committee have provided the fundamental guidance for the China Meteorological Administration to promote the orderly development of commercial meteorological small satellites based on meteorological demands.

In order to implement the important instructions and spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping on meteorological work and the construction of a powerful nation in aerospace, as well as the decisions and deployments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on creating a new growth engine for commercial aerospace, the China Meteorological Administration has fully leveraged its management functions in the meteorological industry. Based on ensuring the continuous and stable provision of global meteorological monitoring by Fengyun meteorological satellites, guided by meteorological needs, driven by technological innovation, and with the goal of high-quality development of meteorology, it has actively explored and promoted the high-quality development environment for commercial meteorological small satellites and applications, and issued the "Guiding Opinions".


**Question: Why is it necessary to support the development and application of commercial meteorological small satellites? What are the specific considerations?**

Answer: The core lies in considering both the "strong system" and the "promotion of development" aspects.

On the one hand, commercial meteorological small satellites can supplement and enhance the observation capabilities of Fengyun meteorological satellites, responding to the demand for higher-precision meteorological services. After more than 50 years of development, China has established a Fengyun meteorological satellite constellation with internationally advanced comprehensive detection capabilities, playing an irreplaceable role in meteorological operations. In recent years, extreme weather events have occurred frequently and repeatedly, and the requirements for meteorological satellite monitoring in disaster prevention and mitigation, as well as weather forecasting and early warning, have continued to increase. Commercial small satellites have the advantages of flexibility, customization, and distribution, which are equivalent to providing "assistants" to Fengyun meteorological satellites. Together, they further enhance the global observation spatial and temporal resolution of certain meteorological elements and strengthen the monitoring and early warning capabilities of severe weather. Currently, China's domestic commercial small satellite constellations such as Tianmu and Yunyao have begun to take shape. After application evaluation, their data effectively supplement the occultation observation capabilities of Fengyun meteorological satellites and play a positive role in meteorological operations such as numerical weather forecasting and weather real-time monitoring. Additionally, it is worth mentioning that developed countries in Europe and America are also actively promoting the development of small meteorological satellites to supplement the observation capabilities of large-platform meteorological satellites. In response to the detection needs of rainstorms, tropical storms, and severe convection, multiple small satellite constellations such as COSMIC and TROPICS have been developed and launched, covering various detection methods such as occultation detection, microwave detection, optical detection, and active radar. Furthermore, through the introduction of policies and the establishment of data procurement mechanisms, a market-oriented development model for small satellites has been formed, and commercial meteorological small satellite data has been procured. These data have played an important role in improving weather forecasting models and enhancing the accuracy of global weather forecasting, providing mature experience for the development and application of China's commercial meteorological small satellites.

On the other hand, we should be guided by meteorological needs to establish a market-oriented benign development mechanism. The core applications of commercial meteorological small satellites focus on meteorological professional fields such as meteorological disaster prevention and mitigation, numerical weather forecasting, and atmospheric real-time operations. The China Meteorological Administration (CMA) needs to put forward business needs and act as a "baton". The CMA has established a full-chain management process for the trial use, evaluation, business access, promotion, and application of commercial meteorological small satellite data, providing support for the promotion of small satellite data. At the same time, starting from the overall pattern of "Fengyun satellites as the mainstay, supplemented by small satellites in coordination", it guides commercial aerospace enterprises to scientifically and reasonably set load indicators, plan constellation layouts, and produce data products, thereby avoiding redundant construction and ensuring efficient resource utilization. Through the benign interaction between demand-side guidance and supply-side optimization, we aim to enhance the manufacturing level, application value, and market competitiveness of domestic commercial meteorological small satellites. Ultimately, this will form a sustainable market-oriented development mechanism, promote the realization of satellite application benefits, and drive the healthy development of this emerging industry.


**Question: What are the main contents of the "Guiding Opinions"?**

Answer: The content of the "Guiding Opinions" is quite comprehensive. It mainly makes arrangements in four aspects: promoting orderly development, optimizing data policies, providing technical support, and encouraging collaborative innovation.

It is worth noting that the "Guiding Opinions" clearly propose to continuously promote the open sharing of basic data from Fengyun meteorological satellites, strengthen data resource integration, support the release of the value of meteorological data elements by commercial meteorological small satellites, leverage the multiplier effect of meteorological data elements, and empower the high-quality development of the economy and society. This has significant exemplary and driving significance for the development of commercial meteorological small satellite enterprises.

In terms of technical support, the "Guiding Opinions" propose to encourage all levels of meteorological departments to apply domestic commercial meteorological small satellites and support the development of such satellites. Make full use of the resources of China Meteorological Administration's ground station network to provide support for cross-calibration, data reception and processing, operation control, etc. of commercial meteorological small satellites, and coordinate the implementation of intensive and intelligent operation of Fengyun meteorological satellites and commercial meteorological small satellites. Encourage meteorological departments to conduct joint application research with commercial meteorological small satellite enterprises, and strengthen the in-depth application of multi-source satellite data in meteorological operations. These measures will promote practical cooperation between meteorological departments and commercial aerospace enterprises.


**Question: After the release of the "Guiding Opinions", what kind of vision will be achieved?**

Answer: The core vision of the "Guiding Opinions" is to establish a "space-based meteorological observation system primarily relying on Fengyun satellites, with commercial satellites providing auxiliary support", to provide new impetus for the high-quality development of meteorology. This can be reflected in three aspects:

First, enhance observation capabilities. Leveraging the strengths of the commercial meteorological small satellite "Xiaokuailing", we will supplement the observation capabilities of Fengyun meteorological satellites and improve the level of refinement in meteorological satellite observations. At the same time, we will utilize commercial small satellites to carry out on-orbit verification of new payloads and technologies, providing scientific and technological support for the payload upgrade of Fengyun satellites. Second, develop the Fengyun constellation. Guide commercial meteorological small satellite enterprises to focus on key areas such as numerical weather forecasting, and develop more tailored small satellite constellations oriented towards meteorological business needs. Form a collaborative "Fengyun+" constellation with Fengyun satellites, featuring "large satellites and small satellites, comprehensive satellites and specialized satellites", through sharing ground station network resources and joint research and application of technologies, allowing commercial small satellites to maximize investment returns. Third, empower industrial development. Promote technological innovation in the field of commercial meteorological small satellites, strengthen professional talent cultivation, coordinate internal and external resources, and form a new development pattern driven by meteorological needs, healthy and orderly development, and in-depth application of satellite data products, to better serve national economic and social development.


**Question: Previously, what efforts did the China Meteorological Administration make regarding the development of commercial meteorological small satellites?**

Answer: The China Meteorological Administration has always adhered to the concept of open cooperation and win-win results, maintained close communication with relevant national departments, and worked closely with commercial meteorological small satellite development units such as the Chinese Academy of Sciences, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation, and private enterprises to jointly promote the development of commercial meteorological small satellites.

In addition to policy support, in recent years, the China Meteorological Administration has taken specific measures to guide the development of commercial meteorological small satellites and promote the realization of application benefits.

In August 2023, the China Meteorological Administration established a special working group for the application of occultation meteorological sounding data, aiming to promote the application of such data in numerical weather forecasting, typhoon monitoring and forecasting, and space weather monitoring and forecasting. In November of the same year, the Tianmu and Yunyao satellite products were shortlisted for the 2023 High-Value Meteorological Data Products of the China Meteorological Administration.

By the end of 2024, commercial meteorological small satellite data was approved to enter the operational system of the China Meteorological Administration for the first time. The "Tianmu-1" constellation, consisting of 23 satellites, and the "Yunyao-1" series, with 12 satellites, were integrated into the comprehensive meteorological observation system of the China Meteorological Administration and commenced operational operations, playing a significant role in the numerical weather forecasting system of the China Meteorological Administration.

In August 2025, in order to promote the internationalization of domestically produced commercial meteorological small satellites, the China Meteorological Administration and the European Organization for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites (EUMETSAT) initiated an application effect evaluation experiment for the data of domestically produced commercial meteorological small satellites in European meteorological satellite operations and numerical weather forecasting. We also look forward to further enhancing the quality and application level of China's commercial meteorological small satellite data through this experiment.


**Question: To promote the development of commercial meteorological small satellites, what other measures will the meteorological department take?**

Answer: The China Meteorological Administration will, as always, guide and promote the development of commercial meteorological small satellites. This includes leading the establishment of a coordination organization composed of national-level operational units, universities, research institutes, and relevant enterprises, setting up a high-level expert technical guidance committee, and organizing seminars, joint innovations, and professional trainings on the application of commercial meteorological small satellites. All units are encouraged to support professional and technical talents in the field of commercial meteorological small satellites in terms of visiting scholars, scientific research projects, education and training, selection and recognition, and guide more resources to gather in the field of commercial meteorological small satellites.

Recently, the list of outstanding contributing enterprises for 2024 in Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone was officially announced. Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd. was successfully included on this list due to its continuous deep involvement in the commercial aerospace sector and its positive contributions to regional development.

This honor not only recognizes the achievements of Yunyao Aerospace in the past year, but also affirms the company's efforts in technological innovation, industrial collaboration, and regional economic empowerment!

![](/media/news/ryjxImg23_260407111819A127.webp)

As a technology enterprise specializing in the research and application of meteorological satellites, Yunyao Aerospace has always focused on the core concept of "technological breakthroughs driving industrial upgrading". It has been steadily advancing in the commercial aerospace field. We have deeply engaged in the research and application of meteorological satellite data, promoting the integration of satellite data into China's meteorological business system. We became the first socialized observation data product provider to pass the data product business access review of the China Meteorological Administration, providing precise and efficient technical support for meteorological forecasting and prediction, oceanic air currents, aviation security, smart cities and other fields. While developing itself, Yunyao Aerospace actively integrates into the industrial ecosystem of Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone, using technological innovation to assist regional industrial upgrading and injecting new impetus of the aerospace field into local economic development.

This recognition as an outstanding contributing enterprise is both an encouragement and a motivation. In the future, Yunyao Aerospace will continue to focus on the deep integration of commercial aerospace and meteorological services, increase investment in technological research and development, expand the boundaries of application scenarios, and give back to society with higher-quality products and services. At the same time, we will continue to deeply engage in the Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone, actively respond to regional development needs, contribute more strength in promoting industrial collaboration and helping to build a scientific and technological innovation ecosystem, and grow and develop together with the region.

**《中国青年报》在3月19日的头版刊发了对云遥宇航创始人兼董事长李峰辉的专访。**

3月17日16时7分，酒泉卫星发射中心，谷神星一号遥十运载火箭飞向太空，将8颗卫星送入太阳同步轨道，其中6颗是来自天津云遥宇航科技有限公司的气象空间遥感卫星。

“截至目前，我们已经发射了40颗卫星。”云遥宇航创始人、董事长李峰辉告诉记者，“本周五还将再发射6颗卫星，一周12颗，这个纪录是史无前例的。”

这家年轻的企业做了许多刷新纪录的事。它是我国第一家，也是目前唯一一家商业气象卫星全链条服务商。6年前，31岁的李峰辉把探索星空的雄心写进“云遥星座计划”，按照他的设想，要在距地球表面500公里至800公里的轨道上，发射90颗气象小卫星，完成全球组网星座计划。

这意味着，从此中国人可以拥有自己的全球商业气象数据，打造出气象界的“北斗系统”，打破国外技术垄断。

![](/media/news/mtImg2_260402180510A175.webp)

![](/media/news/yyImg12_260402180527A176.webp)


**把商用卫星变小 成本降低**

李峰辉曾就职于中国空间技术研究院，长期从事卫星领域研究工作，参与过40多颗卫星的研制工作。他很清楚行业发展的痛点和短板——因为国产卫星少，我国气象数据国产化程度低，常常受制于人。

眼看着国外商用卫星一颗颗发射升空，李峰辉有一种时不我待的紧迫感。2019年还在天津大学读博士时，他就创办了云遥宇航。很快，一支年轻的科研团队集结完毕，核心成员由从事航天科研的资深设计师、气象行业专家等组成。

低成本、高效益，是他们选择的一条卫星商业化之路。李峰辉说，在太空中，多一分重量意味着要付出更高昂的成本，于是研发团队在卫星小型化的技术细节上，做了大量技术更新和迭代。

航天技术从来不是一蹴而就的，每一个细节都要经过很长时间的磨合和验证，“要想方设法做得更好一些，就不得不付出更多的努力。”李峰辉说，“现在我们的产品能做到两公斤左右”。

在位于天津港保税区的云遥宇航公司展厅内，陈列着大大小小的人造气象卫星。它们升入太空后，将成为真正的“千里眼”，当“云遥气象星座”中的“千里眼”越来越多，它们的视线将覆盖全球各个角落。那时，人们可以更加清楚地了解地球每时每刻的“情绪变化”，天气预报能精确到20分钟级。

此前，因为没有自主研发的全球远洋气象导航系统，中国远洋船舶都不得不使用国外公司的气象导航服务，不仅每年要支付几十亿元的服务费，还不得不将船舶技术资料、船舶动态信息提供给对方，对国家安全构成潜在威胁。针对这些情况，云遥宇航研发了全球远洋气象导航系统，2024年6月上线，已经服务了超过300航次。

**打造气象界的“北斗系统”**

“云遥星座计划”正在打破这种“卡脖子”的局面。李峰辉说，“我们一定要从数据源头实现国产化”。他希望通过全球组网，建立一个集全球空间气象数据生产及空间气象数据应用于一体的综合服务平台，生产中国人自己的气象数据。

显示屏上跳动的数字，就是正在地球头顶“奔跑”着的卫星们发回来的。它们的速度非常快，每90分钟就能绕地球一周。每颗卫星上都搭载着“神秘盒子”，那就是云遥GNSS掩星探测载荷，对于天气预报、全球气候变化和地震预报等具有重要价值。

李峰辉解释说，“掩星”的概念来源于天文学，指的是一个天体被另一个天体遮掩的天文现象。科学家们利用自然界的掩星事件，对地球的电离层和中性大气进行测量。当运行中的低轨卫星逐渐远离或接近一颗导航卫星时，后者发出的导航信号，恰好穿过大气层且被前者的掩星天线接收，就发生了一次GNSS掩星事件。

然而，当导航卫星发射的信号穿越大气层后，探测载荷容易出现信号衰减严重、抖动剧烈等技术问题，为此云遥宇航团队又进一步提出了星载掩星事件预报、临边信号开环跟踪算法，使得大气掩星跟踪数量每天增加150条廓线以上，提升了20%的捕获截至角度值。

2024年，云遥气象星座一期12颗卫星已进入中国气象局综合气象观测系统并实现业务运行。这是商业小卫星数据首次获准进入中国气象局业务系统，为我国气象预报预测提供了有力支持。目前，云遥气象星座一期系列卫星每日向中国气象局提供约1.5万条掩星廓线产品，有效提升了风云气象卫星在掩星探测方面的时空分辨率。

**青年创业者找到人生“北斗”**

在打造气象界“北斗导航系统”的征程中，这群年轻科研人员也找到了自己人生的“北斗”。李峰辉透露，除了90颗小卫星，云遥宇航还规划了24颗大卫星，增加了多种探测载荷，探测数据更丰富。

Exclusive interview on the front page of China Youth Daily with Li Fenghui, the chairman of Yunyao Aerospace Company
On the front page of March 19th, China Youth Daily published an exclusive interview with Li Fenghui, the founder and chairman of Yunyao Aerospace. At 16:07 on March 17th, at the Ji

**On the front page of March 19th, China Youth Daily published an exclusive interview with Li Fenghui, the founder and chairman of Yunyao Aerospace.**

At 16:07 on March 17th, at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, the Gusheng-1 Y10 carrier rocket flew into space, sending 8 satellites into sun synchronous orbit, including 6 meteorological space remote sensing satellites from Tianjin Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd.

As of now, we have launched 40 satellites, "Li Fenghui, founder and chairman of Yunyao Aerospace, told reporters." We will launch another 6 satellites this Friday, 12 satellites a week, which is an unprecedented record.

This young enterprise has done many record breaking things. It is the first and currently the only commercial meteorological satellite full chain service provider in China. Six years ago, 31 year old Li Fenghui wrote his ambition to explore the stars into the "Cloud Remote Constellation Plan". According to his plan, he wanted to launch 90 meteorological small satellites in an orbit 500 to 800 kilometers above the Earth's surface to complete the global network constellation plan.

This means that from now on, Chinese people can have their own global commercial meteorological data, create the "Beidou system" in the meteorological industry, and break the monopoly of foreign technology.

![](/media/news/mtImg2_260402184812A003.webp)

![](/media/news/yyImg12_260402184838A004.webp)

**Reduce the size of commercial satellites to lower costs**

Li Fenghui used to work at the China Academy of Space Technology and has been engaged in satellite research for a long time, participating in the development of more than 40 satellites. He is well aware of the pain points and shortcomings in the development of the industry - due to the scarcity of domestically produced satellites, the degree of localization of meteorological data in our country is low, and we are often at the mercy of others.

Watching foreign commercial satellites launch into space one by one, Li Fenghui felt a sense of urgency that time waits for no one. In 2019, while still pursuing his PhD at Tianjin University, he founded Yunyao Aerospace. Quickly, a young research team was assembled, consisting of senior designers engaged in aerospace research, meteorological industry experts, and other core members.

Low cost and high efficiency are the paths they have chosen for satellite commercialization. Li Fenghui said that in space, having more weight means paying higher costs, so the R&D team has made a lot of technological updates and iterations on the technical details of satellite miniaturization.

Aerospace technology is never achieved overnight, and every detail needs to go through a long period of adaptation and verification. "To do better, we have to put in more effort," said Li Fenghui. "Now our products can reach about two kilograms.

In the exhibition hall of Yunyao Aerospace Company located in Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone, artificial meteorological satellites of various sizes are displayed. After they ascend into space, they will become true "thousand mile eyes". As more and more "thousand mile eyes" appear in the "cloud remote weather constellations", their vision will cover every corner of the world. At that time, people could have a clearer understanding of the "emotional changes" on Earth at every moment, and weather forecasts could be accurate to the level of 20 minutes.

Previously, due to the lack of independently developed global ocean meteorological navigation systems, Chinese ocean going vessels had to use meteorological navigation services from foreign companies. They not only had to pay billions of yuan in service fees every year, but also had to provide ship technical data and dynamic information to their counterparts, posing a potential threat to national security. In response to these situations, Yunyao Aerospace has developed a global ocean weather navigation system, which will be launched in June 2024 and has served over 300 voyages.

**Building the 'Beidou System' for the meteorological industry**

The Cloud Remote Constellation Program is breaking this bottleneck situation. Li Fenghui said, 'We must achieve localization from the data source.'. He hopes to establish a comprehensive service platform that integrates global space weather data production and space weather data application through global networking, producing Chinese people's own weather data.

The numbers jumping on the display screen are sent back by the satellites running overhead on Earth. Their speed is very fast, they can orbit the Earth once every 90 minutes. Each satellite is equipped with a "mysterious box", which is the cloud remote GNSS occultation detection payload, which has important value for weather forecasting, global climate change, and earthquake prediction.

Li Fenghui explained that the concept of "occultation" originated from astronomy, referring to the astronomical phenomenon where one celestial body is obscured by another. Scientists use natural occultation events to measure the Earth's ionosphere and neutral atmosphere. When a low orbit satellite in operation gradually moves away from or approaches a navigation satellite, and the navigation signal emitted by the latter passes through the atmosphere and is received by the occultation antenna of the former, a GNSS occultation event occurs.

However, when the signals emitted by navigation satellites pass through the atmosphere, the detection payload is prone to technical problems such as severe signal attenuation and severe jitter. Therefore, the Yunyao Aerospace team further proposed satellite based occultation event prediction and edge signal open-loop tracking algorithms, which increased the number of atmospheric occultation tracking profiles by more than 150 per day and improved the capture cut-off angle value by 20%.

In 2024, the first phase of the Yunyao Meteorological Constellation, consisting of 12 satellites, has entered the comprehensive meteorological observation system of the China Meteorological Administration and achieved operational operation. This is the first time that commercial small satellite data has been approved to enter the operational system of the China Meteorological Administration, providing strong support for meteorological forecasting and prediction in China. At present, the first phase of the Yunyao Meteorological Constellation series satellites provide about 15000 occultation profile products to the China Meteorological Administration daily, effectively improving the spatiotemporal resolution of Fengyun Meteorological Satellites in occultation detection.

**Young entrepreneurs find the "Big Dipper" of life**

In the journey of building the "Beidou Navigation System" in the meteorological industry, these young researchers have also found their own "Beidou" in life. Li Fenghui revealed that in addition to 90 small satellites, Yunyao Aerospace has also planned 24 large satellites, adding various detection payloads and richer detection data.

The first large satellite is expected to be launched by the end of this year, "said Li Fenghui. In this upcoming blueprint, within the next 1-2 years, 24 satellites of the same size as Fengyun Meteorological Satellite, plus 90 small satellites," the production capacity will exceed the sum of the United States and Europe. He believes that by then, China will be able to compete with leading international countries in the field of global meteorological data sources.

In the past few years of entrepreneurship, Li Fenghui feels that he has caught a good time. The rapid development of the country constantly brings new opportunities for entrepreneurs. He calculated that the cost of launching a satellite in 2021 would be 150000 yuan per kilogram, but this year it would only cost 70000 yuan per kilogram, and next year it would have to be reduced. Behind the price reduction is the comprehensive development of the entire industry chain driving cost reduction. Li Fenghui noticed that with the increase of national support, the entire industry is becoming more and more prosperous, and everyone is willing to do research and development. At the same time, the Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone where Yunyao Aerospace settled has provided them with a series of support policies, and the Tianjin Binhai New Area District Committee has also actively addressed the concerns of these young people about entrepreneurship and employment.

A few days ago, the Tianjin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology held a symposium for private manufacturing enterprises to listen to the opinions and suggestions of private entrepreneurs. Li Fenghui spoke as one of the representatives of 10 private enterprises. Yin Jihui, Director of the Tianjin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, stated that it is necessary to respond to and solve the problems of enterprises one by one. For those that cannot be solved immediately, a ledger should be established, and special follow-up should be carried out to fully support private enterprises to operate freely and focus on development.

In recent years, Li Fenghui has become increasingly well-known for launching satellites, and many people like to call this ambitious young man "Tianjin Musk". Upon hearing this address, Li Fenghui smiled and waved his hand repeatedly, saying, "I still have a long way to go." He paused before saying, "But someone must do this.

**Service Case 1: Avoiding Typhoons**
After Typhoon GAEMI made landfall in northern Taiwan at 25:00, it made another landfall in Putian, Fujian Province on the evening of the 25th. The Taiwan Strait and the eastward shipping route were completely blocked. The meteorological department advised to reduce speed, drift safely in a safe position to avoid the typhoon, and provided two different avoidance plans for ships to refer to. Ship A adopted Recommendation Scheme 1, anchoring outside Shenzhen Bay to avoid the typhoon, and resumed navigation in the early morning of the 26th, remaining outside the typhoon's strong wind zone, drifting with the gentle wind towards the north, and passing the tail of the typhoon.

![](/media/news/yyImg14_260402140201A149.webp)

The original route of vessel B was from Singapore to South Korea. Due to the influence of the South China Sea monsoon on November 11th, there was a 11th-level northerly wind with wave heights of about 4-5 meters. We suggest that after leaving the strait, it should head north along the Palawan waterway to basically avoid most of the wind and wave affected areas. Compared to the original route, the voyage is 165 nautical miles longer, but it can arrive at the port 11.5 hours earlier. The optimization effect is obvious: it saves half a day of voyage time and rental costs, and at the same time reduces the impact of severe strong winds and waves on the ship's facilities and cargo. The captain finally executed it.

![](/media/news/yyImg14_260402140309A150.webp)


**Service Case 3: Flight Time Optimization**

The captain suggested that the ship drift along the Philippine coast for 2-3 days. The gas navigation system assessed the impact of the wind and waves based on the actual situation and recommended that the ship resume its northward journey. Eventually, the captain completed the drift for 17 hours and then resumed the journey ahead of schedule, saving nearly one day of excessive drift costs, which was approximately 7,000 US dollars.

New Year's launch! The four meteorological satellites of Yunyao Aerospace have been successfully launched!
On January 20, 2025, at 18:11 Beijing time, China successfully launched four meteorological space remote sensing satellites, namely Cloud-Rover 1-37 to 40, using the Gu Shenxing-1

On January 20, 2025, at 18:11 Beijing time, China successfully launched four meteorological space remote sensing satellites, namely Cloud-Rover 1-37 to 40, using the Gu Shenxing-1 No.16 carrier rocket at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The satellites successfully entered their designated orbits, and the launch mission was a complete success. As of now, Cloud-Rover Aerospace has successfully launched 34 meteorological satellites. This mission was the company's first launch in 2025 and marked the beginning of a new journey in the aerospace field for Cloud-Rover Aerospace in the new year.

![](/media/news/yyImg4_260402112420A115.webp)

![](/media/news/yyImg5_260402112428A116.webp)

The four meteorological remote sensing satellites launched this time are Weibo Member ID Satellite (Cloud Remote Sensing No. 37), Kaiwu Constellation Golden Summit Test Satellite (Cloud Remote Sensing No. 38), Huaqing Haifeng Satellite (Cloud Remote Sensing No. 39), and Cloud Remote Sensing No. 40. The core meteorological detection payloads carried by these satellites are mainly GNSS occultation payloads. The GNSS occultation payloads can obtain information about the temperature, humidity, pressure of the atmosphere and the electron density of the ionosphere by inverting the refractive data of GNSS signals.

Yunyaoyun Aerospace aims to establish a global constellation consisting of 90 commercial meteorological satellites in orbit, forming a real-time global atmospheric and ionosphere detection system. This will serve global weather forecasting and various industries, providing real-time meteorological forecast information with a better than 20-minute latency for countries along the "Belt and Road Initiative", thereby enhancing China's international influence.

据中国气象局官方报道，2024年12月31日，中国气象局全球同化预报系统CMA-GFS V4.2正式投入业务运行，标志着云遥宇航气象卫星掩星观测资料正式进入中国气象局业务系统。

![](/media/news/yyImg3_260402111608A110.webp)

据悉，CMA-GFS V4.2 采用了新研制的全球集合四维变分同化技术；新增风云四号B星及风云三号E星、F星、G星等多台卫星载荷以及云遥等多种国产卫星观测资料，国产卫星资料占比达到18%；优化了模式云物理和降水过程；耦合的海浪模式水平分辨率提升，并优化了海冰参数化方案和风浪涌浪分离技术。冬夏两季的回算试验表明，CMA-GFS V4.2在南北半球及东亚地区均表现出一定的改进效果，长时效强降水和温度预报技巧、全球热带气旋路径和强度预报等性能均有明显提升。

CMA-GFS全球同化预报系统，主要由同化分系统和全球模式分系统两部分组成。自2016年业务化运行以来，中国气象局地球系统数值预报中心对中国气象局全球同化预报系统CMA-GFS在动力框架、物理过程、资料同化、并行计算等方面持续开展研发，系统稳定性和预报效果得以不断强化。
Cloud occultation star data has officially been incorporated into the CMA-GFS V4.2 operational system of the China Meteorological Administration.
According to the official report of the China Meteorological Administration, on December 31, 2024, the CMA-GFS V4.2 global assimilation forecasting system of the China Meteorologic

According to the official report of the China Meteorological Administration, on December 31, 2024, the CMA-GFS V4.2 global assimilation forecasting system of the China Meteorological Administration was officially put into operation, marking that the occultation observation data from the Cloud-Rover Aerospace Meteorological Satellite has officially entered the operational system of the China Meteorological Administration.

![](/media/news/yyImg3_260402111742A111.webp)

It is reported that CMA-GFS V4.2 adopts a newly developed global ensemble four-dimensional variational assimilation technology; it incorporates multiple satellite payloads such as Fengyun-4B, Fengyun-3E, Fengyun-3F, Fengyun-3G, and Cloud Remote Sensing, as well as various domestic satellite observation data, with domestic satellite data accounting for 18%; the cloud physics and precipitation processes of the model have been optimized; the horizontal resolution of the coupled ocean wave model has been improved, and the sea ice parameterization scheme and wind-wave-surf wave separation technology have been optimized. The back-calculation experiments in winter and summer seasons show that CMA-GFS V4.2 demonstrates certain improvement effects in both the Northern and Southern Hemispheres and in the East Asia region. The performance of long-term precipitation and temperature forecasting skills, global tropical cyclone path and intensity forecasting, etc. has significantly improved.

The CMA-GFS global assimilation forecasting system is composed of two parts: the assimilation subsystem and the global model subsystem. Since its operational use in 2016, the Earth System Numerical Prediction Center of the China Meteorological Administration has continuously carried out research and development on the CMA-GFS global assimilation forecasting system of the China Meteorological Administration in terms of the dynamic framework, physical processes, data assimilation, and parallel computing. As a result, the system's stability and forecasting performance have been continuously enhanced.
